description: A warm morning drink of pure ghee in hot water, rooted in Gulf wellness tradition. Ghee's butyric acid lubricates the gut lining and its fat-soluble vitamins A and E support skin barrier function and moisture retention. Best consumed on an empty stomach to support digestion, nutrient absorption, and scalp hydration.
preparation_steps: Warm the water until comfortably hot but not boiling.
Add 1 teaspoon of pure cow ghee to the warm water.
Stir well until the ghee is evenly dispersed.
Consume immediately on an empty stomach.

description: A concentrated antioxidant shot of beetroot, orange, pomegranate, and pumpkin seeds rich in betalains, vitamin C, and zinc. Betalains support liver detoxification to reduce acne and scalp inflammation, while vitamin C boosts collagen synthesis for firm, even skin tone. Pumpkin seeds deliver zinc essential for hair follicle repair, sebum regulation, and preventing hair fall.
primary_goal: Hair repair (Hair fall, Dandruff, Scalp acne & redness)
preparation_steps: Peel and chop the beetroot; peel the orange; measure pomegranate arils.
Add beetroot, orange, pomegranate arils, lemon juice and water to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth.
Strain through a fine mesh sieve if a smoother consistency is desired.
Pour into a shot glass.
Top with pumpkin seeds and serve immediately.

description: A vibrant collagen-supporting drink combining carrot, beetroot, overnight soaked chia seeds, ginger and lemon. Carrot's beta-carotene converts to vitamin A to accelerate skin cell renewal and combat fine lines, while beetroot boosts scalp circulation to stimulate hair follicle activity. overnight  soaked chia seedsadd omega-3 fatty acids that reinforce the skin's moisture barrier and reduce scalp inflammation causing hair fall.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Fine lines & ageing, Pores & texture)
preparation_steps: Soak chia seeds in water overnight (minimum 6–8 hours).
Blend carrot, beetroot, ginger, and water until smooth.
Strain if desired, or keep the fibre for added gut-health benefits.
Add lemon juice, black pepper, soaked chia seeds, and collagen peptides.
Stir well and serve chilled.

description: A traditional morning tonic combining overnight-soaked fenugreek seeds and amla powder stirred into warm Dibs Mint Laban, topped with toasted black sesame seeds. Fenugreek's diosgenin regulates sebum to reduce acne and its mucilage coats the hair shaft to prevent breakage and frizz, while amla's concentrated vitamin C accelerates collagen synthesis. Black sesame seeds support melanin production to delay premature greying.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Pigmentation, Fine lines & ageing, Pores & texture)
Hair repair (Hair fall, Dandruff, Scalp health)
secondary_goal: Gut health and digestion Lifestyle management
preparation_steps: Soak fenugreek seeds in 50 mL water overnight; drain in the morning.
Dry-toast black sesame seeds (Simsim Aswad) over low heat for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour the Dibs Mint Laban into a small saucepan.
Add the drained fenugreek seeds to the laban.
Warm very gently over low heat, stirring constantly; do not boil.
Remove from heat once it reaches a comfortable drinking warmth.
Stir in amla powder until dissolved.
Sprinkle the toasted black sesame over the drink just before serving.
Pour into a clean serving glass or cup and sip slowly.

recipe_name: clove overnight soaked chia seeds and lemon morning drink
description: A refreshing morning drink made with clove-infused water, overnight-soaked chia seeds, and fresh lemon juice to support skin and hair health. Lemon provides vitamin C, which supports collagen synthesis and promotes a brighter complexion. Chia seeds supply omega-3 fatty acids and soluble fiber that help maintain the skin barrier and support scalp health. Cloves contain natural antioxidants and eugenol, which possess antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties that may help support healthy skin.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Pigmentation, Fine lines & ageing, Pores & texture)
Hair repair (Hair fall, Dandruff, Scalp health)
preparation_steps: Soak 2–3 cloves in 250 mL of water overnight or for at least 4–6 hours.
Soak 1 tsp chia seeds separately in water overnight.
Strain the clove-infused water and warm it slightly if desired.
Add the soaked chia seeds and lemon juice.
Stir well and consume on an empty stomach.

description: A refreshing tropical wellness drink made with pineapple, orange, turmeric, and black pepper to support skin health and overall wellness. Pineapple contains bromelain and vitamin C, which help support healthy skin and collagen formation. Orange provides additional vitamin C and antioxidants that contribute to skin elasticity and radiance. Curcumin from turmeric, enhanced by piperine in black pepper, offers antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that support healthy skin and overall wellbeing.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Pigmentation, Fine lines & ageing, Pores & texture)
Hair repair (Hair fall, Dandruff, Scalp health)
preparation_steps: Add pineapple, orange, turmeric, and water to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Strain if preferred.
Add a pinch of black pepper and stir well.
Serve immediately.

description: A refreshing green wellness drink made with celery, cucumber, kiwi, ginger, and lime to support hydration and overall skin health. Celery provides natural antioxidants and phytonutrients that help support the body's normal inflammatory response. Cucumber contributes water and silica, which help maintain skin hydration and support healthy hair. Kiwi is rich in vitamin C and antioxidants that support collagen synthesis and promote healthy-looking skin, while ginger and lime add antioxidant compounds that contribute to overall wellness.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Pigmentation, Fine lines & ageing, Pores & texture)
Hair repair (Hair fall, Dandruff, Scalp health)
preparation_steps: Wash and chop the celery, cucumber, kiwi, and ginger.
Add all ingredients except the lime juice to a blender with the water.
Blend until smooth.
Strain if preferred for a lighter texture.
Stir in the fresh lime juice and serve immediately.

description: A nutrient-rich wellness shot made with guava, lemon, ginger, and black pepper to support skin health and overall wellbeing. Guava is an excellent source of vitamin C and lycopene, which help support collagen synthesis and protect cells from oxidative stress. Lemon adds additional vitamin C, while ginger provides natural antioxidant and anti-inflammatory compounds that support digestive and overall wellness. Black pepper enhances flavor and complements the bioactive compounds present in ginger.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Blackheads & whiteheads, Pores & texture)
preparation_steps: Add guava, lemon juice, ginger, and water to a blender.
Blend until smooth.Strain if preferred for a concentrated shot consistency.
Add a pinch of black pepper and stir well.

description: A refreshing tropical green smoothie made with ripe mango, fresh spinach, coconut water, and ground flaxseed to support skin and hair health. Mango provides beta-carotene and vitamin C, which support healthy skin and collagen formation. Spinach supplies iron, folate, and antioxidants that contribute to healthy hair and overall wellbeing. primary_goal: Skin repair (Pigmentation, Fine lines & ageing, Pores & texture)
preparation_steps: Peel and cube the mango.
Wash the spinach leaves thoroughly.
Add the mango, spinach, and coconut water to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in the ground flaxseed or blend briefly to combine.
Pour into a glass

description: A refreshing hydration drink made with watermelon, fresh mint, and rose water to support skin hydration and overall wellness. Watermelon is rich in water, lycopene, and vitamin C, which help support healthy skin and protect cells from oxidative stress. Fresh mint provides natural antioxidants and a refreshing flavor, while rose water adds a delicate aroma and enhances the beverage's freshness.
preparation_steps: Remove the seeds and cube the watermelon.
Add the watermelon and water to a blender and blend until smooth.
Strain if preferred for a smoother texture.
Stir in the rose water.
Garnish with fresh mint leaves.
Serve chilled or over ice.

description: A refreshing wellness shot made with ripe papaya, food-grade aloe vera gel, and apple cider vinegar to support skin health and digestive wellness. Papaya provides vitamin C, beta-carotene, and antioxidants that support collagen synthesis and healthy-looking skin. Food-grade aloe vera contains naturally occurring polysaccharides that contribute to hydration and overall wellbeing, while apple cider vinegar adds a tangy flavor to this nutrient-rich shot.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Blackheads & whiteheads, Pigmentation, Pores & texture)
preparation_steps: Peel and cube the ripe papaya.
Add the papaya, food-grade aloe vera gel, apple cider vinegar, and water to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into a small shot glass (60–70 mL).
Consume immediately.
Drink a glass of plain water afterward if desired.

description: A vibrant ruby-colored tonic made with dried hibiscus, mixed berries, and raw honey to provide antioxidant support for healthy skin and overall wellness. Hibiscus is naturally rich in anthocyanins and vitamin C, which help protect cells from oxidative stress and support collagen formation. Mixed berries provide polyphenols and antioxidants that contribute to healthy-looking skin, while raw honey adds natural sweetness and beneficial plant compounds.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Aging Skin, Pigmentation, Fine lines & ageing)
preparation_steps: Bring 250 mL of hot water to just below boiling.
Add dried hibiscus flowers (Karkade) to the hot water.
Steep for 5–7 minutes until the water turns a deep ruby red.
Strain the hibiscus flowers out of the liquid.
Add frozen mixed berries to the strained tea.
Stir in raw honey until dissolved.
Allow to cool slightly or serve over ice.
Consume immediately for best flavour and antioxidant potency.

description: A nutrient-rich green shake made with moringa powder, banana, and oat milk to support overall skin, hair, and wellness. Moringa is a source of plant protein, vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants, including vitamin C, iron, and zinc, which contribute to healthy skin and hair. Banana provides natural carbohydrates and potassium for energy, while oat milk adds a creamy texture and complements this nourishing drink.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Fine lines & ageing, Pores & texture)
preparation_steps: Peel and break the banana into chunks.
Add banana, moringa powder, and oat milk to a blender.
Add ice cubes if desired.
Blend on high until creamy and smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.
Consume within 10 minutes for maximum nutrient retention.

description: A fragrant   -inspired warm tonic of fresh ginger and crushed cardamom pods for morning digestion and skin repair. Ginger's gingerols stimulate bile production and reduce gut inflammation linked to acne through the gut-skin axis, while cardamom's cineole accelerates gastric motility and its antioxidants protect skin collagen from oxidative damage and support scalp microcirculation for hair follicle health.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Pigmentation, Aging Skin, Fine lines & ageing)
preparation_steps: Lightly crush cardamom pods using a mortar and pestle to release their oils.
Peel and thinly slice fresh ginger.
Add crushed cardamom, ginger slices, and 300 mL of water to a small saucepan.
Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 7–10 minutes.
Remove from heat and steep for 3 minutes.
Strain into a mug.
Allow to cool to drinking temperature (around 50–60°C).
Stir in fresh lemon juice and raw honey.
Drink slowly on an empty stomach, 20–30 minutes before breakfast.

description: A refreshing citrus drink made with grapefruit, mandarin, and strawberries to provide vitamin C and antioxidants that support overall skin health and wellness. Grapefruit and mandarin contribute vitamin C and flavonoids, while strawberries provide polyphenols and antioxidants that help protect cells from oxidative stress and support normal collagen formation.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Pigmentation, Blackheads & whiteheads, Pores & texture)
preparation_steps: Peel and segment the grapefruit and mandarin.
Hull and halve the strawberries.
Add all fruits and water to a blender.
Blend until completely smooth.
Strain through a fine-mesh sieve for a smoother texture if preferred.
Serve immediately, chilled.

description: A refreshing juice made with apple, beetroot, carrot, ginger, and lemon to provide vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants that support overall wellness. Apple contributes polyphenols, beetroot provides naturally occurring nitrates and antioxidants, while carrot is rich in beta-carotene, which the body converts to vitamin A to support healthy skin. Ginger and lemon add antioxidant compounds and a refreshing flavor to this nutrient-rich beverage.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Pigmentation, Acne, Fine lines & ageing, Pores & texture)
Hair repair (Hair fall, Greying hair, Scalp health)
preparation_steps: Wash, peel, and chop the apple, beetroot, and carrot into small chunks.
Peel the ginger.
Add apple, beetroot, carrot, ginger, and water to a blender or juicer.
Blend on high for 60–90 seconds until completely smooth (blender method).
Strain through a fine-mesh sieve or nut milk bag for a clear juice, or keep the fibre for added gut-health benefits.
Stir in fresh lemon juice.
Serve immediately over ice. Consume within 20 minutes of preparation for maximum nutrient retention.

description: A nourishing morning drink prepared by soaking raisins overnight in water, offering natural antioxidants, minerals, and plant compounds that support overall skin and hair wellness. Raisins provide polyphenols that help protect cells from oxidative stress, while their iron and copper contribute to normal red blood cell formation and oxygen transport, supporting healthy skin and hair. Potassium helps maintain fluid balance, and consuming the soaked raisins adds dietary fiber that supports digestive health, an important factor for maintaining healthy-looking skin.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Pigmentation, Acne, Fine lines & ageing, Aging Skin)
preparation_steps: Rinse the raisins thoroughly under running water to remove dust and residues.
Place the raisins in a clean glass or ceramic cup.
Pour 250 mL of filtered water over the raisins.
Cover and soak overnight for 8–12 hours at room temperature.
In the morning, strain the water into a glass.
Add ½ tsp lemon juice if desired for extra vitamin C synergy.
Drink the infused water slowly on an empty stomach.
You may also eat the soaked raisins afterwards for added fibre and iron benefit.

description: A refreshing green wellness shot made with cucumber, spinach, lemon, amla, and ginger, providing vitamins, minerals, antioxidants, and phytonutrients that support healthy skin and hair. Cucumber contributes water and silica to help maintain skin hydration, while spinach provides iron, folate, and vitamins A and C that support normal cell function and overall hair health
primary_goal: Skin repair (Pigmentation, Acne, Pores & texture, Fine lines & ageing, Blackheads & whiteheads)
Hair repair (Hair fall, Dandruff, Scalp health, Greying hair)
preparation_steps: Wash the cucumber, spinach, and ginger thoroughly.
Chop the cucumber into rough chunks (no need to peel if skin is smooth).
If using fresh amla, deseed and chop it; if using amla powder, set aside.
Add cucumber, spinach, ginger, and water to a blender.
Blend on high for 60 seconds until smooth.
Strain through a fine-mesh sieve or muslin cloth for a clearer juice.
Stir in lemon juice and amla (fresh blended in or powder stirred in).
Serve immediately chilled for the best freshness and to preserve heat-sensitive nutrients such as vitamin C.

description: A concentrated citrus shot combining carrot, orange, lemon, and ginger for skin brightening and anti-ageing. Carrot's beta-carotene converts to retinol, reducing fine lines and renewing skin cells, while orange's vitamin C stimulates collagen synthesis and hesperidin reduces acne inflammation. Ginger's gingerols boost scalp microcirculation to activate dormant hair follicles and reduce hair fall.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Pigmentation, Fine lines & ageing, Pores & texture, Blackheads & whiteheads)

preparation_steps: Peel and chop the carrot into small chunks.
Peel and segment the orange, removing all seeds.
Peel the ginger.
Add carrot, orange, ginger, and water to a blender.
Blend on high for 60–90 seconds until completely smooth.
Serve without straining to retain dietary fibre and nutrients, or strain if a smoother shot consistency is preferred.
Stir in lemon juice and a pinch of black pepper if using.
Pour into a shot glass (60–80 mL) and consume immediately on an empty stomach.
Chase with a glass of plain warm water to aid absorption.

description: A refreshing wellness juice made with carrot, orange, coconut water, fresh curry leaves, and ginger, providing vitamins, minerals, antioxidants, and phytonutrients that support healthy hair and skin. Curry leaves contain iron, beta-carotene, and plant antioxidants that contribute to overall hair health, while carrot provides beta-carotene, which the body converts to vitamin A to support normal skin and scalp maintenance. primary_goal: Hair wellness (Healthy hair, Healthy scalp, Hair nourishment)
preparation_steps: Wash and peel the carrot and ginger.
Peel and segment the orange, removing all seeds.
Wash the curry leaves thoroughly.
Add the carrot, orange, ginger, curry leaves, and coconut water to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Serve without straining to retain dietary fibre and nutrients, or strain if a smoother texture is preferred.
Serve immediately chilled for the best freshness and to preserve heat-sensitive nutrients such as vitamin C.

description: A nourishing wellness drink made with black sesame seeds and amla, providing antioxidants, minerals, and phytonutrients that support healthy hair and skin. Black sesame seeds are a natural source of copper, iron, calcium, healthy fats, and plant antioxidants that contribute to normal cellular function and overall hair health. Amla is rich in vitamin C and polyphenols, which support normal collagen formation and help protect cells from oxidative stress, contributing to healthy-looking skin and hair when consumed as part of a balanced diet.
primary_goal: Hair repair (Greying hair, Hair fall, Scalp health)
secondary_goal: Skin repair (Pigmentation, Fine lines & ageing, Aging Skin)
preparation_steps: Soak the black sesame seeds in water overnight for 8–12 hours.
Drain and rinse the soaked seeds.
Add the soaked sesame seeds and warm water to a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Strain if a smoother texture is preferred, or consume without straining to retain dietary fibre.
Stir in the amla powder until well combined.
Add raw honey if desired and mix well.

recipe_name: Pearl Coast Breakfast with Berry Antioxidant Smoothie
description: Smoked salmon on sourdough with labneh and a berry antioxidant smoothie    a skin-radiance powerhouse breakfast. Omega-3 fatty acids from salmon reduce scalp inflammation and strengthen hair follicles, while astaxanthin protects skin from UV-induced ageing and supports collagen integrity.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Pigmentation, Fine lines & ageing, Pores & texture)
Hair repair (Hair fall, Premature greying, Scalp health)
allergens: Dairy, Fish, Gluten, Tree Nuts, Seeds
preparation_steps: Soak chia seeds in almond milk with a pinch of cardamom; refrigerate overnight or min 2 hrs; stir before serving.
Toast sourdough bread until golden and crispy.
Spread labneh evenly over the warm toast.
Layer smoked salmon slices on top of the labneh.
Mince garlic and rub lightly over the salmon; add a squeeze of lemon juice.
For the berry smoothie: blend mixed berries with remaining almond milk and honey until smooth.
Stir soaked chia seeds into the smoothie; pour into a glass.
Serve salmon toast alongside the berry chia smoothie immediately.

description: A traditional labneh and za'atar dip with whole wheat Khameer bread, pumpkin seeds, and olive oil. Labneh's probiotics strengthen the gut-skin axis to reduce inflammation and acne, while za'atar's thyme and sumac provide antioxidants that protect skin cells from oxidative damage.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Pores & texture, Fine lines & ageing)
Hair repair (Hair fall, Dandruff, Scalp health)
preparation_steps: Mix labneh with za'atar and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil in a bowl until well combined.
Spread the labneh mixture onto a serving plate.
Drizzle remaining olive oil over the top.
Sprinkle pumpkin seeds generously over the labneh.
Warm whole wheat Khameer bread in a dry pan 1-2 min per side until soft.
Arrange warm Khameer bread alongside the labneh dip.
Serve immediately.

description: Warm Emirati Chebab pancakes with Medjool dates, walnuts, and date-walnut filling    a heritage hair repair breakfast. Dates provide natural iron that oxygenates hair follicles to reduce fall, while walnuts deliver ALA omega-3 fatty acids and copper that strengthen hair shafts and support melanin production to delay greying.
primary_goal: Hair repair (Hair fall, Premature greying, Scalp acne & redness)
preparation_steps: Dissolve saffron in 1 tbsp warm water; rest 5 min.
Mix whole wheat flour, egg, cardamom, yeast, saffron water and warm water into a smooth batter; rest 15 min.
Heat a non-stick pan with a little ghee over medium-low heat.
Pour small rounds of  batter; cook 2-3 min per side until golden and cooked through.
Pit and slice Medjool dates; arrange on a serving plate.
Toast walnut halves in a dry pan 2 min until fragrant; place alongside dates.
Drizzle raw honey over the Chebab pancakes.
Serve Chebab warm with dates, walnuts and honey on the side.

recipe_name: Royal Garden Breakfast Board with Saffron Pomegranate Smoothie
description: A nourishing breakfast board with walnuts, boiled egg, mixed berries, spinach, and whole wheat Khameer bread. Walnuts provide ALA omega-3 fatty acids and biotin that strengthen hair follicles and support scalp health, while the egg delivers complete protein and selenium essential for hair keratin synthesis.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Pores & texture, Dry skin)
preparation_steps: Place egg in cold water; bring to boil; cook 7-8 min; cool and peel.
Soak chia seeds in 3 tbsp water 10 min until gel forms; set aside.
Dissolve saffron in 1 tbsp warm water; blend with pomegranate seeds and almond milk until smooth for the smoothie.
Wash baby spinach; toss with lemon juice and olive oil; arrange on a board.
Halve boiled egg; place on the board alongside walnut halves and mixed berries.
Spoon soaked chia seeds into a small bowl on the board.
Warm Khameer bread in a dry pan 1-2 min; place on the board.
Pour saffron pomegranate smoothie into a glass; serve everything together immediately.

recipe_name: Egg, Hummus & Spinach Power Sandwich with Citrus Collagen Smoothie
description: A protein-rich breakfast of boiled eggs with hummus and fresh spinach in whole wheat bread for skin and hair repair. Eggs provide biotin and complete protein. the two most critical nutrients for hair keratin production.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Pores & texture, Fine lines & ageing)
Hair repair (Hair fall, Scalp health, Dandruff)
preparation_steps: Place eggs in cold water; bring to a boil; simmer 8 min for hard-boiled; cool and peel; slice.
Toast whole wheat bread slices until golden.
Spread hummus generously over both toast slices.
Layer fresh spinach over the hummus.
Arrange boiled egg slices and halved cherry tomatoes on top.
Drizzle olive oil and a squeeze of lemon over the filling.
Close sandwich; cut diagonally.
For the citrus collagen smoothie: blend orange juice with lemon juice and a pinch of pink salt; serve chilled alongside.

recipe_name: Halloumi & Avocado Sandwich with Papaya Skin Renewal Smoothie
description: Grilled halloumi with creamy avocado on whole wheat bread, paired with a papaya skin renewal smoothie. Halloumi provides calcium and complete protein for hair shaft strength and skin collagen support, while avocado's oleic acid and vitamin E deeply nourish the scalp .
primary_goal: Skin repair (Pigmentation, Fine lines & ageing, Pores & texture)
preparation_steps: Slice halloumi 1 cm thick; pat dry; grill in a dry pan over medium-high heat 2-3 min per side until golden.
Halve avocado; mash with lemon juice, pink salt and black pepper until smooth.
Toast whole wheat bread slices until golden.
Spread mashed avocado over both toast slices.
Layer grilled halloumi on top; close sandwich and cut diagonally.
For the papaya smoothie: blend papaya with almond milk and honey until smooth; serve chilled alongside.
Serve sandwich and smoothie immediately.

recipe_name: Hair Repair Breakfast with Berry Biotin Smoothie
description: A hair-targeted breakfast combining omega-3-rich walnuts, biotin-packed eggs, and iron-rich spinach with a berry smoothie. Walnuts' ALA omega-3 fatty acids reduce scalp inflammation and strengthen hair shafts, while eggs provide complete protein and selenium critical for hair keratin synthesis.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Aging Skin, Pigmentation, Fine lines & ageing)
Hair repair (Hair fall, Greying hair, Scalp health)
preparation_steps: Place eggs in cold water; bring to boil; cook 7-8 min; cool and peel; halve.
Sauté baby spinach in olive oil with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt for 2 min; set aside.
Toast walnut halves in a dry pan 2 min until fragrant.
Toast whole wheat bread slice until golden.
Arrange boiled eggs, sautéed spinach and toasted walnuts in a bowl.
Drizzle lemon juice and olive oil over the bowl.
For the berry biotin smoothie: soak chia seeds in almond milk 10 min; blend with mixed berries until smooth.
Serve egg bowl with toast and berry smoothie alongside.

recipe_name: Baith Tomat Protein with Green Glow Smoothie
description: A traditional Emirati egg and tomato dish delivering complete protein, lycopene, and folate for skin and hair repair. Eggs provide biotin and selenium    the two most critical nutrients for hair keratin synthesis while tomato's lycopene neutralises UV-induced free radicals to protect skin collagen and reduce acne-causing inflammation.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Pigmentation, Fine lines & ageing, Pores & texture)
preparation_steps: Finely dice onion and chop tomatoes; set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium heat with a drizzle of oil.
Add onion; sauté 3–4 min until golden and softened.
Add chopped tomatoes; cook 5 min stirring until they break down into a sauce.
Season with salt, pepper and a pinch of cumin.
Whisk eggs and pour over the tomato mixture; stir gently to scramble.
Cook on low heat 3–4 min until eggs are just set and creamy.
Squeeze lime juice over the top; serve hot.

description: A skin-nourishing overnight oats bowl with chia seeds, almond milk, and mixed berries    prepared effortlessly the night before. Oats provide beta-glucan fibre that feeds beneficial gut bacteria to strengthen the gut-skin axis and reduce acne-causing inflammation, while chia seeds' omega-3 fatty acids reinforce the skin's lipid moisture barrier..
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Pores & texture, Fine lines & ageing, Pigmentation)
Hair repair (Hair fall, Scalp health, Dandruff)
preparation_steps: Prepare the night before:
Combine rolled oats, chia seeds and almond milk in a jar; stir well.
Add a pinch of cinnamon and a drizzle of honey; stir again.

Cover and refrigerate overnight for minimum 6-8 hours.
 In the morning:
Remove from refrigerator; stir well    add a splash of almond milk if too thick.
Wash mixed berries; hull and halve strawberries.
Top overnight oats with mixed berries.
Scatter toasted almond flakes over the top.
Drizzle a little honey to finish; serve chilled.

description: A regal Emirati breakfast plate of saffron-infused labneh, smoked salmon, avocado, and whole wheat Khameer bread. Saffron's crocin and crocetin inhibit melanin overproduction to reduce pigmentation.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Pigmentation, Fine lines & ageing, Aging Skin, Pores & texture)
Hair repair (Hair fall, Premature greying, Scalp health)
preparation_steps: Bloom saffron strands in 1 tbsp warm water for 5-10 min until golden.
Mix labneh with the bloomed saffron water until evenly golden.
Warm Khameer bread in a dry pan over medium heat 1-2 min per side until lightly crispy.
Spread saffron labneh generously over the warm bread.
Halve and pit avocado; slice thinly and arrange on top of the labneh.
Layer smoked salmon slices alongside the avocado.
Drizzle olive oil and lemon juice over everything.
Garnish with fresh coriander; serve immediately.

description: Sardine fillets with smashed avocado and pumpkin seeds on thin Emirati Regag bread for skin elasticity and hair strength. Sardines' EPA and DHA reduce scalp inflammation, stimulate hair follicle circulation.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Pigmentation, Fine lines & ageing, Aging Skin, Pores & texture)
Hair repair (Hair fall, Premature greying, Scalp health)
preparation_steps: Halve and pit avocado; scoop flesh into a bowl.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, pink salt and chopped fresh coriander until smooth but slightly chunky.
Warm Emirati Regag bread in a dry pan over medium heat 1-2 min per side until lightly crispy.
Spread mashed avocado evenly over the warm Regag bread.
Open sardine tin; drain oil; lay fillets neatly over the avocado.
Sprinkle pumpkin seeds generously over the sardines.
Add a squeeze of extra lemon juice if desired.
Serve immediately while bread is still crispy.

description: Scrambled eggs with pumpkin seeds on whole wheat Khameer bread and sliced avocado for hair keratin and skin repair. Eggs deliver biotin, selenium, and complete protein    the foundation nutrients for strong hair shaft formation    while pumpkin seeds provide zinc and magnesium to reduce hair fall and regulate oil production. Avocado's vitamin E and oleic acid deeply nourish the scalp and strengthen the skin's moisture barrier.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Pigmentation, Fine lines & ageing, Aging Skin, Pores & texture)
Hair repair (Hair fall, Premature greying, Scalp health)
preparation_steps: Crack eggs into a bowl; add pink salt and black pepper; whisk until light and combined.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat until shimmering.
Pour in the whisked eggs; let the base set 30 seconds without stirring.
Gently fold the eggs with a spatula in slow strokes    keep them soft and fluffy.
Remove from heat when eggs are just set; stir in pumpkin seeds immediately.
Halve avocado; slice and arrange on a serving plate.
Warm whole wheat Khameer bread in a dry pan 1-2 min until soft.
Plate scrambled eggs with pumpkin seeds, avocado slices and Khameer bread; serve hot.

description: A vibrant Emirati shakshuka with eggs poached in spiced tomato sauce, enriched with sardines for skin and hair repair. Eggs provide biotin and selenium critical for hair keratin production, while sardines' EPA and DHA reduce scalp inflammation and support skin lipid barrier integrity.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Pigmentation, Fine lines & ageing, Pores & texture)
Hair repair (Hair fall, Greying hair, Scalp health)
preparation_steps: Heat olive oil in a wide oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Sauté diced onion and garlic 3-4 min until softened and golden.
Add chopped bell pepper; cook 3 min.
Add chopped tomatoes, cumin, paprika, salt and pepper; stir and cook 8-10 min until sauce thickens.
Make 2-3 small wells in the sauce with a spoon; crack eggs carefully into each well.
Cover pan with a lid; cook on medium-low heat 5-6 min until egg whites are fully set.
Garnish with fresh chopped parsley.
Serve hot directly from the pan with a slice of whole wheat bread.

recipe_name: Salmon & Egg Scramble with Avocado & Spinach
description: Pan-cooked salmon flakes scrambled with eggs, avocado, and wilted spinach for hair keratin and skin glow. Salmon's omega-3 fatty acids reduce scalp inflammation and astaxanthin protects skin from UV-induced collagen breakdown, while eggs provide biotin and complete protein for hair shaft strength.

Hair repair (Hair fall, Greying hair, Scalp health)
preparation_steps: Cut salmon fillet into small bite-sized chunks; season with lemon juice, pink salt and black pepper.

Cook salmon pieces 2–3 min turning once until just cooked through.
Whisk eggs with a pinch of salt; pour over the salmon in the pan.
Fold gently with a spatula until eggs are just set    do not overcook.

Mash avocado with lemon juice, pink salt and red chili flakes until smooth but slightly chunky.
Spoon smashed avocado beside the eggs on the plate.

recipe_name: Saffron Egg Frittata with Berries & Walnuts
description: A saffron-infused egg frittata with baby spinach and cherry tomatoes, paired with walnuts and mixed berries. Saffron's crocin brightens skin pigmentation and reduces oxidative stress that accelerates skin ageing, while eggs provide biotin and selenium for hair keratin synthesis.
primary_goal: Skin repair (Acne, Pores & texture, Fine lines & ageing)
Hair repair (Hair fall, Dandruff, Scalp health)
preparation_steps: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F).
Dissolve saffron in 1 tsp warm water; whisk into eggs with pink salt and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add cherry tomatoes; sauté 2 min until slightly blistered; add baby spinach and wilt 1 min.
Pour saffron egg mixture evenly over the vegetables; shake pan gently to level.
Cook on stovetop 2 min until edges just begin to set.
Transfer pan to the oven; bake 8–10 min until frittata is fully set and lightly golden on top.
Slice frittata; plate with mixed berries and crushed walnuts on the side; serve immediately.

description: Saffron chia seed pudding with mixed berries, pomegranate seeds, and fresh camel milk for skin radiance and hair nourishment. In the morning stir the chia pudding well; add a splash of water if too thick.
Stir in ground flaxseeds; mix evenly into the pudding.
Spoon chia pudding into a wide serving bowl.
Top generously with fresh mixed berries and pomegranate seeds.
Warm whole wheat Khubz in a dry pan 1–2 min until soft; serve alongside.

description: The vitamin C from cherry tomatoes and lemon juice in this plate significantly enhances non-heme iron absorption from spinach, lentils, and chickpeas  always pair plant iron with vitamin C for maximum benefit.

description: Fresh mango with Chami labneh, smoked salmon, soaked chia seeds, and pumpkin seeds for comprehensive skin and hair nutrition. preparation_steps: Preheat oven to 200°C; peel and dice sweet potato (150 g) into 2 cm cubes.
Infuse saffron strands in 2 tbsp warm water; rest 5 min until golden.
Toss sweet potato with saffron water, olive oil, turmeric and a pinch of salt; roast 22-25 min until caramelised.
Rinse red lentils; sauté onion and garlic in olive oil 4 min until golden.
Add tomatoes and cumin; cook 8 min; add lentils and water; simmer 20 min until thick.
For tahini drizzle: whisk tahini with lemon juice, garlic and water into a smooth sauce.
For herb salad: chop fresh mint and parsley; toss with diced cucumber, lemon juice and olive oil.
Bowl: red lentils as base; top with roasted saffron sweet potato; drizzle tahini; serve herb salad alongside.

recipe_name: Musabbaha with Chicken Arseeyah & Tomato Parsley Salad
description: Whole simmered chickpeas in tahini-lemon sauce with chicken arseeyah and a bright tomato parsley salad. Chickpea selenium and tahini zinc support hair keratin production and scalp health, while vitamin C from tomatoes and parsley enhances iron absorption for hair follicle oxygenation.
preparation_steps: For the Whole Wheat Bread:
Mix whole wheat flour, yeast, pink salt and warm water into a soft dough; knead 2 min.
Rest dough 15 min; roll into a thin round on a lightly floured surface.

Cook on a hot dry griddle 1-2 min each side until lightly puffed and cooked through; keep warm.
For the Musabbaha:
Simmer chickpeas (120 g, soaked overnight) in water with a pinch of salt for 35-40 min until very tender; reserve cooking liquid.
Warm chickpeas gently; mash 1/3 of them roughly, leaving rest whole    this is musabbaha texture.
Mix with tahini, garlic, lemon juice, cumin and a splash of cooking liquid until creamy.

Transfer to a wide bowl; drizzle olive oil and sprinkle paprika over top.
For the Chicken Arseeyah:

Slow-cook chicken breast with cardamom and water until very soft; mash into smooth arseeyah; season with salt.
For the Tomato Parsley Salad:

Dice tomatoes and onion; toss with fresh parsley, lemon juice, olive oil and salt until combined.
To Serve:
Plate musabbaha in a wide bowl; serve chicken arseeyah and tomato parsley salad alongside.
Serve warm whole wheat bread on the side.

recipe_name: Chicken Spinach Saloona with Lentil Tabbouleh
description: Emirati saloona of tender chicken and spinach in a spiced tomato broth with lentil tabbouleh salad. Spinach iron and folate oxygenate hair follicles to reduce fall, while chicken's complete protein and B vitamins support hair keratin synthesis and skin collagen production.
preparation_steps: Heat olive oil in a pot; sauté diced onion and garlic 4 min until golden.
Add chicken breast pieces; brown 3-4 min on each side.
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, cumin and a little water; bring to boil.
Reduce heat; simmer covered 20-25 min until chicken is very tender.
Add fresh spinach; stir and cook 5 min until wilted.
Season with salt and pepper; add a squeeze of lemon juice.
For lentil tabbouleh: cook lentils until just tender; cool. Finely chop parsley and mint; dice tomatoes and cucumber.
Toss lentils with herbs, tomatoes, cucumber, lemon juice and olive oil.
Serve chicken spinach saloona with lentil tabbouleh alongside.

recipe_name: Fish Sayadieh with Chicken Arseeyah & Cabbage Salad
description: Classic caramelised onion fish sayadieh rice with chicken arseeyah and crisp cabbage salad. Fish omega-3 fatty acids reduce scalp inflammation and support skin barrier integrity, while B vitamins from the grain and chicken support hair keratin synthesis and skin cell renewal.
preparation_steps: Caramelise sliced onions (80 g) in olive oil over low heat 25-30 min until deeply golden.
Season white fish fillet with turmeric, cumin, salt and lemon; pan-fry 3-4 min each side; flake fish.
Reserve pan juices; add water/fish stock with cinnamon and cardamom to make spiced broth.
Add washed basmati rice to the broth with caramelised onions; cook 18-20 min until tender.
Slow-cook chicken breast with cardamom and water until very soft; mash into smooth arseeyah.
For cabbage salad: shred cabbage; toss with lemon juice, parsley and a pinch of salt.
Plate sayadieh rice topped with flaked fish; serve arseeyah and cabbage salad alongside.

recipe_name: Chicken & Vegetable Jareesh with Beetroot Parsley Salad
description: Traditional Emirati crushed wheat jareesh with tender chicken and mixed vegetables, served with beetroot parsley salad. Jareesh's B vitamins and biotin nourish the scalp to reduce hair fall, while chicken provides complete protein for hair keratin synthesis and collagen production.
preparation_steps: Soak crushed wheat/jareesh (120 g) in cold water 30 min; drain well.
Heat olive oil in a large pot; sauté diced onion and garlic 4 min until golden.
Add chicken pieces; cook 5-6 min until browned.
Add soaked jareesh, chicken stock, turmeric, cumin, coriander and bezaar.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat; stir constantly for 35-40 min until thick and creamy.
Shred chicken into the jareesh; stir well; season with salt.
In the last 10 min, stir in diced zucchini and carrot until just tender.
For beetroot parsley salad: grate cooked beetroot; toss with fresh parsley, lemon juice and olive oil.
Serve jareesh in wide bowls; plate beetroot salad alongside.

recipe_name: Quinoa Bowl with Tofu Mushroom Curry, Kale & Beetroot Salad
description: A plant-powered quinoa bowl with tofu mushroom curry, massaged kale, and roasted beetroot salad. Quinoa provides all essential amino acids for hair keratin synthesis, while mushroom vitamin D supports hair follicle cycling and reduces scalp inflammation.
preparation_steps: Cook quinoa (80 g dry) in water 1:2 ratio for 15 min; fluff with fork; set aside.
Press firm tofu; cut into 2 cm cubes; pan-fry in olive oil until golden on all sides.
In the same pan sauté onion, garlic and ginger; add cumin, turmeric and coriander; cook 3 min.
Add chopped tomatoes; cook 8 min until sauce thickens.
Add mushrooms and tofu; stir in coconut milk; simmer 10 min.
For kale salad: massage kale with lemon juice and olive oil until tender.
For beetroot salad: dice cooked beetroot; toss with lemon juice and olive oil.
Bowl: quinoa as base; top with tofu mushroom curry; serve kale and beetroot salads alongside.

recipe_name: Grilled Sheri Fish with Organic Quinoa, Chicken Arseeyah & Mixed Salad
description: Grilled Sheri fish with organic quinoa, chicken arseeyah, and a fresh mixed salad. Sheri's omega-3 fatty acids reduce scalp inflammation and protect skin lipid barrier integrity, while quinoa provides complete protein with all amino acids for hair keratin synthesis.
preparation_steps: Marinate sheri fish with turmeric, cumin, garlic, lime juice and olive oil for 20 min.
Grill sheri on preheated grill 4-5 min each side until cooked through and lightly charred.
Cook quinoa (70 g dry) in water 15 min; fluff with fork; season with salt.
Slow-cook chicken breast with cardamom and water until very soft; mash into smooth arseeyah.
For mixed salad: dice tomatoes, cucumber, lettuce and radish; toss with lemon juice and olive oil.
Plate quinoa; place grilled sheri on top.
Serve chicken arseeyah and mixed salad alongside.

recipe_name: Brown Rice with Shrimp Tomato Curry, Kale & Spinach Citrus Salad
description: Nutty brown rice with bold shrimp tomato curry topped with vibrant kale and spinach citrus salad. Shrimp provides iodine and selenium to support thyroid function    critical for preventing hormonal hair fall    while kale sulforaphane and spinach iron oxygenate hair follicles.
preparation_steps: Cook brown rice (80 g dry) in water 30 min; fluff.
Heat olive oil in a pan; sauté diced onion, garlic and ginger 4 min until golden.
Add turmeric, cumin and coriander; cook 2 min.
Add chopped tomatoes; cook 8 min until sauce thickens.
Add cleaned shrimp; cook 3-4 min until pink and cooked through.
Stir in coconut milk; simmer 5 min; season with salt.
For kale & spinach citrus salad: massage kale with lemon; add spinach and orange segments; toss with olive oil and lemon juice.
Plate brown rice; top with shrimp tomato curry; serve salad alongside.

recipe_name: Mishkak Chicken Skewers with Whole Wheat Khameer & Cucumber Yogurt
description: Juicy Emirati mishkak chicken skewers in bezaar spice marinade with whole wheat khameer and cucumber mint yogurt. Lean chicken delivers complete protein for hair keratin synthesis, while yogurt probiotics maintain the gut-skin microbiome to reduce scalp acne and redness.
preparation_steps: Cube chicken breast (200 g); marinate in bezaar spice, turmeric, cumin, minced garlic, lemon juice and olive oil for at least 1 hour.
Thread marinated chicken onto skewers.
Grill on preheated grill or griddle pan 3-4 min each side until cooked through and charred at edges.
For khameer bread: mix whole wheat flour with yeast, warm water and a pinch of salt; knead 5 min; rest 1 hour until risen.
Cook khameer on a hot dry griddle 3-4 min per side until puffed and cooked through.
For cucumber yogurt: dice cucumber; mix with yogurt, minced garlic, fresh mint, lemon juice and salt.
Serve mishkak skewers with warm khameer bread and cucumber yogurt on the side.

recipe_name: Freekeh with Chicken Broccoli Curry, Bell Peppers & Pomegranate Salad
description: Smoky freekeh grain with chicken and broccoli curry, bell peppers, and a jewelled pomegranate salad. Broccoli's sulforaphane activates cellular detoxification enzymes to reduce acne-causing toxins, while bell pepper's vitamin C enhances iron absorption for hair follicle oxygenation.
preparation_steps: Cook freekeh (70 g dry) in water 25 min; fluff with a fork.
Cube chicken breast (160 g); sauté in olive oil 5-6 min until golden.
Add diced onion and garlic; cook 3 min; add cumin, turmeric and coriander.
Add chopped tomatoes, broccoli florets and diced bell peppers; stir well; add a splash of water.
Simmer covered 15 min until broccoli and bell peppers are tender and chicken is cooked through.
For pomegranate bell pepper salad: dice roasted or raw bell peppers; toss with pomegranate seeds, fresh parsley and lemon juice.
Plate freekeh; top with chicken broccoli curry; serve pomegranate salad alongside.

recipe_name: Baked Turkey Kefta with Sweet Potato & Tossed Broccoli Salad
description: Oven-baked turkey kefta with roasted sweet potato and crunchy broccoli salad for skin and hair repair. Turkey provides selenium and vitamin B12 linked to reducing premature hair loss and supporting hair pigmentation, while sweet potato's beta-carotene converts to vitamin A for skin cell renewal.
preparation_steps: Mix turkey mince (200 g) with finely diced onion, minced garlic, chopped parsley, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, paprika and salt until well combined.
Shape into elongated kefta rolls about 10 cm long.
Arrange on an oiled baking tray; drizzle with a little olive oil.
Bake at 200°C for 20-22 min until cooked through and lightly golden.
Meanwhile, dice sweet potato (180 g) into 2 cm cubes; toss with olive oil and salt; roast at 200°C for 22-25 min until caramelised.
For broccoli salad: blanch broccoli florets 3 min; toss with lemon juice, olive oil and a pinch of salt; serve at room temperature.
Plate turkey kefta with roasted sweet potato and broccoli salad alongside.

recipe_name: Quinoa with Shrimp Coconut Curry & Garlic Spinach Sunflower Seed Salad
description: Fluffy quinoa with aromatic shrimp coconut curry and garlicky spinach and sunflower seed salad. Shrimp's iodine and selenium support thyroid function to prevent hormonal hair fall, while sunflower seeds' vitamin E is the most studied nutrient for skin moisture barrier repair.
preparation_steps: Cook quinoa (70 g dry) in water 15 min; fluff with fork.
Sauté diced onion, garlic and ginger in olive oil 4 min until golden.
Add cumin, turmeric and coriander; cook 2 min.
Add chopped tomatoes; cook 8 min; stir in coconut milk; simmer 5 min.
Add cleaned shrimp; cook 3-4 min until pink and cooked through; season with salt.
For garlic spinach sunflower salad: sauté minced garlic in olive oil; add spinach; wilt 2 min; cool. Add toasted sunflower seeds and lemon juice; toss.
Plate quinoa; top with shrimp coconut curry; serve garlic spinach sunflower salad alongside.

recipe_name: Grilled Chicken Wrap with Creamy Herb Yogurt Sauce & Beetroot Slaw
description: A whole wheat wrap with spiced grilled chicken, herb yogurt sauce, and crunchy beetroot slaw. Lean chicken delivers complete protein for hair keratin synthesis, and yogurt probiotics maintain the gut-skin axis to reduce acne and scalp inflammation.
preparation_steps: Slice chicken breast (160 g); season with cumin, garlic, lemon juice and olive oil; marinate 30 min.

For herb yogurt sauce: mix yogurt with minced garlic, chopped parsley, chopped mint, lemon juice and a pinch of cumin.

Warm whole wheat flatbread on a dry pan 1 min per side.
Spread herb yogurt sauce generously over the flatbread.
Layer grilled chicken slices down the centre; add beetroot slaw on top.
Roll tightly; slice in half; serve immediately.

recipe_name: Yuuma Deyay (Lemon Chicken) with Saffron Brown Rice & Arabic Salad
description: Emirati slow-cooked lemon chicken over saffron brown rice with fresh tomato-cucumber Arabic salad. Vitamin C from lemon directly stimulates collagen synthesis, while saffron's crocin inhibits melanin overproduction to brighten pigmentation.

Cook brown rice in water with saffron water and a pinch of salt for 30 min.
Dice tomatoes and cucumber; mix with parsley, lemon juice and olive oil for Arabic salad.
Plate saffron rice topped with lemon chicken; serve Arabic salad alongside.

recipe_name: Charred Veggie Medley with Okra Stew & Chicken Arseeyah
description: A smoky charred medley of seasonal vegetables with spiced okra stew and comforting chicken arseeyah. Diverse vegetables provide vitamins A, C, and K that collectively support skin cell renewal, collagen synthesis, and antioxidant protection, while okra mucilage reduces gut inflammation linked to acne.
preparation_steps: For the Basmati Rice:
Rinse basmati rice (60 g) under cold water until water runs clear; soak 10 min; drain.
Add rice to a saucepan with 120 ml salted water; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to lowest setting; cover with a tight lid and cook 12-15 min until water is absorbed.

Remove from heat; rest covered 5 min; fluff with a fork and keep warm.
For the Charred Veggie Medley:
Toss zucchini, eggplant, bell peppers, cherry tomatoes and red onion with olive oil and salt.

Spread on a lined baking tray; roast at 220°C for 25-30 min until charred at edges, turning once halfway.
For the Okra Stew:
Heat olive oil in a pan; sauté minced garlic for 1 min until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes, cumin and turmeric; cook 8 min until thick and fragrant.

Add trimmed okra and 150 ml water; simmer covered 15 min until okra is tender.
For the Chicken Arseeyah:
Slow-cook chicken breast with cardamom and water over low heat 25-30 min until very soft.

Remove chicken; mash into smooth arseeyah using a fork; season with salt.
To Serve:
Plate fluffy basmati rice as the base.
Arrange charred vegetables alongside the rice.
Spoon okra stew and chicken arseeyah over the plate.
Garnish with fresh coriander and a squeeze of lemon juice; serve immediately.

recipe_name: Jareesh Robian Gulf Shrimp  with Caramelised Onions & Arabic Salad
description: Slow-cooked Gulf shrimp and crushed wheat jareesh with caramelised onions and crisp Arabic salad. Slow-caramelise sliced onions in olive oil over low heat 30 min until deeply golden.
Bring shrimp stock to boil; add soaked wheat, stir constantly on medium-low heat for 30–40 min until smooth and thick.
Add shrimp in the last 10 min of cooking; stir through with bezaar and spices.
Dice tomatoes and cucumber; toss with parsley, lemon juice and olive oil.
Plate jareesh topped with caramelised onions; serve Arabic salad alongside.

recipe_name: Vegetarian Harees with Broccoli & Citrus Salad
description: Slow-cooked vegetarian harees of crushed wheat to a silky porridge, served with broccoli and citrus salad. Whole wheat's prebiotic fibre feeds beneficial gut bacteria to reduce systemic inflammation linked to acne and skin sensitivity, while broccoli's sulforaphane activates skin cellular detoxification.

Finish harees with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of cinnamon.
Steam or blanch broccoli florets 3–4 min until bright and tender-crisp.
Segment orange and grapefruit; toss with fresh mint and lemon juice.
Serve harees in a bowl with broccoli and citrus salad on the side.

recipe_name: Koshary Heritage Platter with Whole Wheat Khameer Bread & Rocket Pomegranate Salad
description: Layered brown rice, lentils, and macaroni with tomato dakkous sauce and caramelised onions, with rocket pomegranate salad. Lentil iron and folate oxygenate hair follicles and reduce anaemia-related hair fall, while pomegranate's ellagitannins inhibit collagen-degrading enzymes for firmer skin.

Caramelise sliced onions in olive oil until deep golden.
Blend tomatoes with garlic, cumin, coriander, chili and vinegar; cook into dakkous sauce 15 min.
Make khameer: mix flour, yeast, warm water; rest 1 hour; cook on griddle.
Layer rice and lentils in a dish; top with dakkous sauce and caramelised onions.
Toss rocket with pomegranate seeds, lemon juice and olive oil.
Serve koshary with khameer bread and salad.

recipe_name: Chicken Jareesh with Roasted Nuts, Bezaar Okra & Beetroot Parsley Salad
description: Rich Emirati chicken jareesh with roasted nuts, bezaar-spiced okra, and beetroot parsley salad. Roasted nuts' magnesium reduces cortisol-driven hair fall and vitamin E protects scalp cells from oxidative damage, while chicken collagen supports skin elasticity and hair shaft strength.

Shred cooked chicken into the jareesh.
Toast nuts in a dry pan until golden.
Cook okra with garlic, tomatoes and bezaar spice until tender.
Grate beetroot; toss with parsley, lemon juice and olive oil.
Plate jareesh, top with toasted nuts; serve bezaar okra and beetroot salad alongside.

recipe_name: Fresh Plain Yogurt with Whole Wheat Khameer Bread, Chicken Arseeyah & Cucumber Mint Salad
description: A probiotic-rich Emirati lunch of plain yogurt with warm whole wheat khameer bread, chicken arseeyah, and cucumber mint salad. Yogurt probiotics strengthen the gut-skin axis to reduce acne-causing inflammation and support a healthy scalp microbiome, while whole wheat provides biotin and B vitamins that nourish hair follicles.
preparation_steps: Prepare khameer: mix flour, yeast, warm water; rest 1 hour; cook on hot griddle.
Slow-cook chicken with cardamom and water until very soft; mash into smooth arseeyah.
Slice cucumber thin; toss with chopped mint, lemon juice and a drizzle of olive oil.
Plate fresh yogurt alongside warm khameer, chicken arseeyah and cucumber mint salad.

recipe_name: Stuffed Eggplant & Fava Plate with Whole Wheat Khameer Bread & Citrus Salad
description: Roasted eggplants stuffed with spiced fava beans, with whole wheat khameer bread and vibrant citrus salad. Eggplant anthocyanins protect skin collagen from UV oxidative degradation and inhibit acne-causing bacteria, while fava beans' plant protein and folate support hair keratin synthesis.
preparation_steps: Halve eggplants; brush with olive oil; roast at 200°C for 25 min until soft.
Cook fava beans with onion, garlic, tomatoes, cumin and coriander for 15 min; mash lightly.
Fill eggplant halves with fava mixture; return to oven 10 min.
Prepare khameer: mix flour, yeast, water; rest; griddle-cook.
Segment orange and lemon; toss with fresh mint and a drizzle of olive oil.
Serve stuffed eggplant with khameer and citrus salad.

recipe_name: Green Bean & White Bean Braise with Whole Wheat Khameer Bread, Garlic Broccoli & Chaas
description: Hearty green and white bean braise in herbed tomato sauce with khameer bread, garlic broccoli, and chaas. Prebiotic fibre from the beans feeds beneficial gut bacteria to reduce systemic inflammation linked to acne and skin sensitivity, while broccoli sulforaphane activates skin cellular detoxification.

Add green beans and white beans; pour water to cover; simmer 25 min until tender.
Steam broccoli 3 min; toss with sautéed garlic, olive oil and lemon juice.
Prepare khameer: mix flour, yeast, water; rest 1 hour; griddle-cook.
Serve chaas chilled with a pinch of cumin and salt.
Plate bean braise with khameer, garlic broccoli and chaas on the side.

recipe_name: Qar'a Bezaar Rice with Tahini Lemon Sauce & Soya Chunks
description: Emirati pumpkin rice with bezaar spices, soya chunks, and creamy tahini-lemon sauce. Pumpkin's beta-carotene converts to vitamin A to regulate sebum and reduce acne, while phytoestrogens from soy support hormonal hair loss management and skin hydration.
preparation_steps: Soak soya chunks in hot water 20 min; squeeze out water; set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil; add bezaar, turmeric and cumin.
Add diced pumpkin; cook 5 min.
Add soaked rice and water; cook 25–30 min until pumpkin and rice are tender.
Pan-fry soya chunks with a little olive oil and spice until slightly crispy.
Mix tahini with lemon juice, garlic and water into a smooth sauce.
Plate bezaar rice topped with soya chunks; drizzle tahini sauce and garnish with coriander.

recipe_name: Freekeh with Grilled Hammour, Spinach & Orange Cucumber Sesame Salad
description: Smoky freekeh with grilled hammour (grouper), iron-rich wilted spinach, and sesame cucumber salad. Hammour's omega-3 fatty acids reduce scalp inflammation and support the skin's lipid barrier integrity, while freekeh's B vitamins and biotin nourish hair follicles to prevent fall.

Marinate hammour in turmeric, cumin, garlic and lime juice; grill 4–5 min each side.
Sauté spinach with garlic in olive oil until wilted.
Segment orange; combine with sliced cucumber and sesame seeds; dress with lemon juice and olive oil.

recipe_name: Chicken Shawarma Bowl with Arabic Salad
description: Spiced chicken shawarma strips over brown rice or freekeh with a crisp tomato-cucumber-parsley Arabic salad. Cook on high heat in a pan or grill until slightly charred.
Cook brown rice until tender.
Dice tomatoes, cucumber, onion and parsley; toss with lemon juice and olive oil for Arabic salad.
Assemble: rice base, shawarma chicken on top, Arabic salad alongside.

recipe_name: Fish Hammour Grilled with Chicken Arseeyah & Mixed Greens Pumpkin Seed Salad
description: Emirati-spiced grilled hammour with silky chicken arseeyah and mixed greens pumpkin seed salad. Hammour's omega-3 fatty acids reduce scalp inflammation and protect skin lipid barrier integrity, while pumpkin seeds provide magnesium and zinc to reduce cortisol-driven hair fall and regulate sebum.

Slow-cook chicken with cardamom until soft; mash into arseeyah.
Toast pumpkin seeds lightly.
Toss mixed greens and cucumber with pumpkin seeds, lemon juice and olive oil.
Plate grilled hammour with arseeyah; serve salad alongside.

recipe_name: Chicken Shish Tawook with Beetroot Tabbouleh & Cucumber Yogurt Salad
description: Yogurt-marinated chicken shish tawook with vibrant beetroot tabbouleh and cooling cucumber yogurt salad. Yogurt probiotics maintain the gut-skin microbiome balance to reduce acne and scalp inflammation, while beetroot nitrates improve scalp microcirculation to stimulate hair follicle growth.

Thread onto skewers; grill 4 min each side.
Cook bulgur; mix with finely chopped parsley, mint, tomatoes and grated beetroot; dress with lemon and olive oil.
Dice cucumber; mix with yogurt, garlic and mint for salad.

recipe_name: Kingfish Sayadieh with Chicken Arseeyah & Grilled Vegetables
description: Fragrant caramelised onion kingfish sayadieh rice with chicken arseeyah and grilled vegetables. Grill zucchini and bell pepper with olive oil until charred.

recipe_name: Brown Rice with Lentil Curry & Grilled Tofu Mushroom Sesame Bowl
description: Brown rice with rich lentil curry and sesame-dressed grilled tofu and mushroom bowl. Mushroom vitamin D supports hair follicle cycling and reduces scalp inflammation, while sesame lignans and tofu isoflavones protect skin from oxidative ageing and support hormonal hair loss management.

Add lentils and water; simmer 25 min until thick curry.
Press and cube tofu; grill with sesame oil until golden.

recipe_name: Turmeric Salmon with Freekeh & Roasted Beet-Walnut Salad
description: Turmeric-crusted Atlantic salmon on smoky freekeh with roasted beet and walnut salad. Salmon's omega-3 fatty acids reduce scalp inflammation and astaxanthin protects skin from UV-induced collagen breakdown, while curcumin reduces oxidative stress that causes fine lines and acne.

description: Heritage brown rice and lentil bowl with tomato garlic dakkous sauce, crispy onions, and beetroot yogurt salad. Complete plant protein from the rice-lentil pairing provides all amino acids for hair keratin synthesis, while yogurt probiotics reduce acne-causing gut dysbiosis.

Layer rice and lentils; top with dakkous sauce and caramelised onions.

recipe_name: Brown Rice with Paneer Bell Pepper Curry, Spinach Stir-Fry & Pomegranate Salad
description: Brown rice with vibrant paneer and bell pepper curry, garlicky spinach stir-fry, and pomegranate salad. Calcium from paneer and iron from spinach together strengthen hair shafts and oxygenate follicles to reduce fall, while bell pepper's vitamin C dramatically enhances iron absorption.

Stir-fry spinach with garlic and olive oil 3 min.
Toss pomegranate seeds with lemon juice and olive oil.
Plate brown rice with curry, spinach stir-fry and pomegranate salad.

recipe_name: Grilled Sheri Fish with Saffron Rice & Rocket Pomegranate Salad
description: Grilled Sheri fish over golden saffron rice alongside a vibrant rocket and pomegranate salad. Sheri omega-3 fatty acids reduce scalp inflammation and protect skin barrier integrity for fewer fine lines, while saffron crocin inhibits melanin overproduction to brighten skin tone.
