recipe_name: Brown Rice with Mixed Bean Curry, Cucumber Bell Pepper Salad & Mint Yogurt
description: Hearty brown rice with mixed bean curry, crunchy cucumber bell pepper salad, and cooling mint yogurt. Complete plant protein from the rice-bean pairing provides all amino acids for hair keratin synthesis, while yogurt probiotics reduce acne-causing inflammation through gut-skin axis support.
preparation_steps: Cook brown rice 30 min; fluff.
Sauté onion, garlic, ginger; add spices and tomatoes; cook 8 min.
Add mixed beans and water; simmer 20 min until thick curry.
Dice cucumber and bell pepper; toss with lemon juice and olive oil.
Mix yogurt with chopped mint, lemon juice and salt.
Plate brown rice with bean curry; serve salad and mint yogurt alongside.

recipe_name: Zaatar Crusted Chicken with Brown Rice & Spinach Pomegranate Salad
description: Chicken encrusted in fragrant zaatar herb blend, oven-baked with brown rice and spinach pomegranate salad. Thyme and sumac in zaatar provide powerful antioxidants that protect skin from UV oxidative damage and reduce acne-causing inflammation, while sesame seeds' lignans support collagen integrity.
preparation_steps: Press zaatar blend firmly onto both sides of chicken breast with olive oil.
Bake at 200°C for 22–25 min until golden and cooked through.
Cook brown rice 30 min; fluff.
Toss fresh spinach with pomegranate seeds, lemon juice and olive oil.
Slice zaatar chicken; plate over brown rice with spinach pomegranate salad alongside.

recipe_name: Gulf Lobster with White Rice & Grilled Vegetables
description: Gulf lobster in Emirati spices with fragrant white rice and charred seasonal grilled vegetables. Lobster delivers exceptional zinc for sebum regulation and acne prevention, selenium for hair follicle protection, and omega-3 for skin lipid barrier integrity.
preparation_steps: Split lobster; brush with garlic butter/olive oil, turmeric and lemon; grill flesh-side down 5 min.
Cook basmati rice in seasoned water 18 min; fluff.
Toss vegetables with olive oil and salt; grill at 220°C for 20 min until charred.
Serve grilled lobster with rice and grilled vegetables; garnish with fresh parsley and lemon.

recipe_name: Spiced Quail with Bulgur Wheat, Leafy Greens, Carrot & Cucumber Salad
description: Bezaar-spiced whole quail on fluffy bulgur wheat with leafy greens, carrot, and cucumber salad. Quail delivers high-quality complete protein and B vitamins critical for hair keratin production and scalp health, while its iron and zinc support follicle oxygenation and sebum regulation.
preparation_steps: Clean quail; rub with bezaar, turmeric, cumin, garlic and olive oil.
Roast at 200°C for 25–30 min until golden.
Cook bulgur with water 1:
5 ratio for 12 min; fluff.
Grate carrot; slice cucumber; toss with leafy greens, lemon juice and olive oil.
Plate bulgur wheat, place roasted quail on top; serve salad alongside.

recipe_name: Seafood Saloona with Saffron Rice & Beetroot Parsley Salad
description: Rich Emirati mixed seafood saloona of shrimp, fish, and squid in spiced tomato broth with saffron rice and beetroot salad. Mixed seafood provides exceptional iodine, selenium, and omega-3 for thyroid support, hair follicle nourishment, and skin barrier repair, while saffron crocin reduces melanin overproduction for brighter skin.
preparation_steps: Cook saffron rice: simmer basmati with saffron water 18 min; fluff.
Sauté onion and garlic; add bezaar, turmeric, cumin and loomi; cook 5 min.
Add tomatoes and water; simmer 10 min.
Add seafood mix; cook 8–10 min until just cooked.
Grate beetroot; toss with parsley, lemon juice and olive oil.
Plate saffron rice with seafood saloona poured over; serve beetroot salad alongside.

recipe_name: Lentil Eggplant Musaka'a with Whole Wheat Khubz & Rocket Pomegranate Salad
description: Baked layered eggplant and lentil musaka'a in tomato sauce with whole wheat khubz and rocket pomegranate salad. Eggplant anthocyanins protect skin collagen from UV oxidative damage and inhibit acne-causing bacteria, while lentil iron oxygenates hair follicles to reduce fall.
preparation_steps: Slice eggplant; brush with olive oil; grill or roast at 200°C for 20 min.
Cook lentils until tender.
Sauté onion and garlic; add tomatoes and spices; cook 10 min.
Layer eggplant and lentils in a baking dish; pour tomato sauce over; bake at 180°C for 20 min.
Make khubz: mix flour, yeast, water; rest; bake.
Toss rocket with pomegranate, lemon and olive oil.
Serve musaka'a with khubz and salad.

recipe_name: Mishkak Chicken Skewers with Whole Wheat Khameer & Cucumber Yogurt Salad
description: Emirati mishkak chicken skewers in bezaar marinade with whole wheat khameer and cucumber mint yogurt salad. Lean chicken provides complete protein for hair keratin synthesis, and yogurt probiotics maintain the gut-skin microbiome to reduce scalp acne and redness.
preparation_steps: Marinate cubed chicken in bezaar, turmeric, cumin, garlic, lemon and olive oil 1 hour.
Thread onto skewers; grill 3–4 min each side.
Make khameer: mix flour, yeast, warm water; rest 1 hour; griddle-cook until puffed.
Dice cucumber; mix with yogurt, chopped mint, garlic and lemon.
Serve skewers with warm khameer and cucumber yogurt.

recipe_name: Chicken Maglooba with Saffron Rice & Mango Pomegranate Salad
description: Classic Levantine-Emirati maglooba of layered chicken, vegetables, and aromatic rice, served with mango pomegranate salad. Lean chicken delivers complete protein for hair keratin synthesis and skin collagen production, while diverse vegetables provide vitamins A, C, and K for comprehensive skin antioxidant protection.
preparation_steps: Fry eggplant and cauliflower slices in a little olive oil until golden; drain.
Marinate chicken in spices; pan-fry until cooked.
Infuse saffron in warm water.
Layer tomato slices, fried vegetables, chicken, and parboiled rice in a deep pot.
Pour saffron water and stock over; cook on medium 10 min then low heat 25 min.
Rest 10 min; flip onto platter.
Dice mango; toss with pomegranate, mint and lemon juice. Serve salad alongside.

recipe_name: Chicken & Spinach Shish Barak with Laban Sauce & Emirati Garden Salad
description: Levantine shish barak dumplings filled with chicken and spinach in tangy laban sauce, with Emirati garden salad. Laban probiotics maintain the gut-skin microbiome balance to reduce acne-causing dysbiosis, while spinach iron and folate oxygenate hair follicles to reduce fall.
preparation_steps: Make dough: mix flour, water and salt; rest 30 min; roll thin.
Mince chicken; sauté with onion, garlic, spinach, cumin and cinnamon.
Cut dough into circles; fill with chicken spinach mixture; fold and seal into dumplings.
Simmer laban in a pot, stirring constantly; add cornstarch slurry to stabilise.
Cook shish barak in the laban sauce 15 min.
Finish with dried mint and garlic sauté.
Prepare garden salad; dress with lemon and olive oil. Serve.

recipe_name: Zucchini & Tomato Vegetable Saloona with Lentil Vermicelli Rice & Herb Drizzle
description: Light Emirati vegetable saloona of zucchini and tomatoes in spiced broth with lentil vermicelli rice and herb oil drizzle. Zucchini silicon strengthens hair shafts and nail structure by supporting connective tissue formation, while lentil folate supports hair follicle cell renewal and reduces fall.
preparation_steps: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil; add cumin and turmeric; cook 3 min.
Add tomatoes, zucchini and water; simmer 20 min.
Cook lentils until just tender.
Toast vermicelli in a little olive oil until golden.
Add rice, lentils and water; cook 25 min.
Blend parsley, coriander and mint with olive oil and lemon for herb drizzle.
Plate lentil vermicelli rice; pour saloona alongside; drizzle herb oil.

recipe_name: Red Lentil & Brown Rice Mujadara with Caramelised Onion & Arugula Salad
description: Levantine red lentil and brown rice mujadara with deeply caramelised onions and peppery arugula salad. Complete plant protein from the rice-lentil pairing provides all amino acids for hair keratin synthesis, while caramelised onions' quercetin reduces scalp inflammation and sulphur compounds stimulate hair growth.
preparation_steps: Slow-caramelise sliced onions in olive oil 30 min until deep golden and sweet.
Cook lentils in water with garlic 15 min; add soaked rice and cumin; cook 25 min more until thick.
Season mujadara with coriander and salt.
Toss arugula with pomegranate seeds, lemon juice and olive oil.
Plate mujadara topped with caramelised onions; serve arugula salad alongside.

recipe_name: Grilled Halloumi Mezze Plate with Za'atar, Garden Salad & Whole Wheat Pita
description: Golden grilled halloumi with zaatar, garden salad, hummus, olives, and warm whole wheat pita. Calcium from halloumi and antioxidant thyme and sumac from zaatar reduce scalp inflammation to improve follicle health, while tahini sesame lignans support collagen integrity for firmer skin.
preparation_steps: Blend chickpeas with tahini, garlic, lemon juice and olive oil for hummus.
Slice halloumi; dust with zaatar; grill or pan-fry without oil 2–3 min each side.
Chop tomatoes, cucumber and lettuce; toss with lemon juice.
Make pita: mix flour, yeast, water; rest; roll; bake 220°C 6 min.
Arrange mezze: grilled halloumi, garden salad, hummus, olives with warm pita.

recipe_name: Stuffed Vine Leaves with Tahini Sauce, Emirati Garden Salad & Chickpea Herb Salad
description: Vine leaves stuffed with spiced rice and herbs in lemon broth, with tahini sauce, garden salad, and chickpea herb salad. Vitamin K from vine leaves supports skin wound healing and collagen cross-linking, while sesame lignans from tahini protect hair follicles from oxidative damage.
preparation_steps: Blanch vine leaves 2 min.
Cook rice until parboiled; mix with parsley, mint, cumin, allspice and salt.
Fill vine leaves; roll tightly; arrange in pot.
Pour lemon juice and olive oil over; add water to cover; simmer 40 min.
Mix tahini with lemon juice, garlic and water.
Toss chickpeas with parsley, mint, lemon and olive oil.
Chop garden salad vegetables.
Serve vine leaves with tahini and both salads.

recipe_name: Chickpea & Spinach Emirati Curry with Whole Wheat Khubz
description: Emirati-spiced curry of whole chickpeas and spinach in fragrant tomato and bezaar sauce with whole wheat khubz. Chickpea iron and spinach folate oxygenate hair follicles to reduce fall, while vitamin C from tomatoes dramatically enhances iron absorption for maximum follicle nourishment.
preparation_steps: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil. Add bezaar, turmeric, cumin, coriander; cook 3 min.
Add tomatoes; cook 8 min.
Add chickpeas and water; simmer 20 min.
Stir in spinach; cook 5 min until wilted.
Add lemon juice and adjust seasoning.
Make khubz: mix flour, yeast, water; rest; roll thin; bake at 220°C 8 min.
Serve curry with warm whole wheat khubz.

recipe_name: Baked Falafel with Sesame-Roasted Cauliflower & Tahini Herb Salad
description: Crispy oven-baked chickpea falafel with golden sesame-roasted cauliflower and fresh tahini herb salad. Cauliflower sulforaphane activates cellular detoxification enzymes to reduce acne-causing oxidative stress, while sesame lignans from tahini and chickpea zinc support hair keratin production and scalp health.
preparation_steps: Soak chickpeas overnight; blend with parsley, coriander, onion, garlic, cumin and baking powder.
Shape into balls; brush with olive oil; bake at 200°C 22 min.
Toss cauliflower florets with sesame seeds and olive oil; roast at 220°C for 25 min until golden.
Mix tahini with lemon juice, garlic and water; toss with remaining herbs for salad.
Plate falafel and sesame cauliflower; serve tahini herb salad alongside.

recipe_name: Whole Roasted Cauliflower (Zahra) with Tahini, Lentil Tabbouleh & Herb Salad
description: Whole roasted cauliflower with creamy tahini sauce, protein-enriched lentil tabbouleh, and herb salad. Cauliflower sulforaphane is one of the most potent natural activators of cellular detoxification to reduce acne, while tahini sesame lignans protect hair follicles from oxidative damage.
preparation_steps: Blanch whole cauliflower 5 min; dry.
Rub with turmeric, cumin, paprika, garlic and olive oil.
Roast whole at 200°C for 35–40 min until deeply golden.
Cook lentils and bulgur separately; cool and mix with finely chopped parsley, mint, tomatoes, lemon and olive oil.
Mix tahini with lemon juice, garlic and water.
Toss remaining herbs with lemon and olive oil.
Plate whole cauliflower, drizzle tahini; serve tabbouleh and herb salad.

recipe_name: Pumpkin & Lentil Stew with Whole Wheat Khubz & Fresh Grapes
description: Warming Emirati pumpkin and lentil stew in cumin-spiced tomato broth with whole wheat khubz and fresh grapes. Pumpkin beta-carotene converts to vitamin A to regulate sebum and brighten skin pigmentation, while lentil iron oxygenates hair follicles to reduce fall.
preparation_steps: Sauté onion and garlic; add cumin, turmeric, coriander; cook 3 min.
Add diced pumpkin and tomatoes; cook 10 min.
Add lentils and water; simmer 25 min until thick.
Season and add lemon juice.
Make khubz: mix flour, yeast, water; rest; roll; bake 220°C.
Plate pumpkin lentil stew with warm khubz; serve fresh grapes on the side.

recipe_name: Eggplant & Tomato Vegetable Moussaka with Tahini Béchamel & Whole Wheat Khubz
description: Mediterranean layered moussaka of roasted eggplant and tomato sauce with tahini béchamel and whole wheat khubz. Eggplant anthocyanins and tomato lycopene create a powerful antioxidant combination that inhibits acne-causing bacteria and protects skin collagen, while tahini sesame lignans support hair follicle health.
preparation_steps: Slice eggplant; salt 15 min; rinse; grill until soft.
Sauté onion and garlic; add tomatoes, cumin, cinnamon, turmeric; cook 12 min.
Layer eggplant and tomato sauce in a baking dish.
Mix tahini with lemon juice, garlic and water for béchamel; pour over.
Bake at 180°C for 25 min.
Make khubz: mix flour, yeast, water; rest; bake.
Serve moussaka with warm khubz.

recipe_name: Okra Stew with Basmati Rice & Paneer Salad
description: Emirati-spiced okra stew in tomato and loomi broth over basmati rice with fresh paneer salad. Okra mucilage and anti-inflammatory compounds reduce gut inflammation linked to acne and skin sensitivity, while loomi vitamin C supports collagen synthesis for firmer skin.
preparation_steps: Sauté onion and garlic; add cumin, turmeric and loomi; cook 3 min.
Add tomatoes; cook 8 min.
Add okra and water; simmer 20 min until tender.
Cook basmati rice in seasoned water 18 min.
Cube paneer; pan-fry or grill until golden.
Toss paneer with cucumber, cherry tomatoes, mint, lemon and olive oil.
Plate rice with okra stew; serve paneer salad alongside.

recipe_name: Fish Sayadieh with Baked Kingfish Fillet, Broccoli & Bell Peppers
description: Classic caramelised onion sayadieh rice with tender baked kingfish, broccoli, and vibrant bell peppers. Kingfish omega-3 fatty acids reduce scalp inflammation and protect skin lipid barrier integrity, while broccoli sulforaphane activates skin cellular detoxification to reduce acne.
preparation_steps: Caramelise onions slowly in olive oil 25 min.
Season kingfish with turmeric, cumin and lemon; bake at 190°C 20 min.
Cook rice in spiced fish broth with caramelised onions 20 min.
Steam broccoli 3 min until tender-crisp.
Grill bell peppers with olive oil until slightly charred.
Plate sayadieh rice topped with baked kingfish; serve broccoli and peppers alongside.

recipe_name: Tamarind-Spiced Grilled Tofu with Lemon Herb Broth
description: Tamarind and bezaar-spiced grilled tofu with warm lemon herb broth and a fresh side salad. Tamarind's tartaric acid and tofu's plant-based iron together brighten skin pigmentation and protect collagen from UV oxidative damage, while lemon vitamin C stimulates collagen synthesis and maximises non-heme iron absorption from tofu and saffron rice.
preparation_steps: Mix tamarind paste with bezaar, turmeric, cumin, garlic, lemon juice and olive oil.
Coat tofu slices thoroughly; marinate 30 min.
Grill on high heat 4 min each side until charred and golden.
Warm water with lemon juice, parsley and coriander for herb broth.
Slice tomatoes and cucumber for side salad; dress with lemon.
Serve grilled tofu with warm lemon herb broth and salad.

recipe_name: Chicken Majboos with Quinoa & Green Vegetables
description: Modern Emirati quinoa majboos with spiced chicken in tomato-loomi broth and green vegetables. Quinoa provides complete protein with all amino acids for hair keratin synthesis    superior to rice in this classic dish    while loomi vitamin C supports collagen production.
preparation_steps: Marinate chicken in bezaar, turmeric, cumin and lemon 30 min.
Sauté onion and garlic; add chicken; brown 5 min.
Add tomatoes, loomi and cardamom; cook 8 min.
Add water; simmer 20 min.
Add quinoa; cook 15 min until tender.
Steam zucchini, spinach and green beans 4 min.
Plate chicken quinoa majboos; serve green vegetables alongside.

recipe_name: Quinoa Tabbouleh Bowl with Paneer, Hummus & Roasted Vegetables
description: A vibrant quinoa tabbouleh bowl with grilled spiced paneer, creamy hummus, and colourful roasted vegetables. Complete protein from quinoa and paneer provides all amino acids for hair keratin synthesis and skin collagen production, while parsley's vitamin K and C support skin wound healing.
preparation_steps: Cook quinoa; cool.
Finely chop parsley and mint; dice tomatoes; toss with quinoa, lemon juice and olive oil for tabbouleh.
Marinate paneer in cumin, garlic and lemon; grill 3-4 min each side.
Blend chickpeas with tahini, garlic and lemon for hummus.
Toss peppers, zucchini and eggplant with olive oil; roast at 200°C 25 min.
Assemble bowl: tabbouleh base, grilled paneer, hummus and roasted vegetables.

recipe_name: Grilled Sea Bass with Freekeh, Kale & Citrus Salad
description: Elegantly grilled sea bass on smoky freekeh with massaged kale and bright citrus salad. Sea bass omega-3 fatty acids reduce scalp inflammation and protect skin lipid barrier integrity, while freekeh's prebiotic fibre feeds beneficial gut bacteria to reduce acne-causing inflammation.
preparation_steps: Marinate sea bass in turmeric, cumin, garlic and lemon; grill 4–5 min each side.
Cook freekeh in water 25 min; fluff.
Massage kale with lemon juice and olive oil until tender.
Segment orange and grapefruit; toss with mint and lemon juice.
Plate freekeh, place grilled sea bass on top; serve massaged kale and citrus salad.

recipe_name: Avocado Brown Rice Bowl with Miso-Sesame Dressing & Edamame
description: Nutty brown rice with crispy tofu, creamy avocado, edamame, and umami miso-sesame dressing. Tofu's plant-based selenium and isoflavones support thyroid function to prevent hormonal hair fall, while avocado's oleic acid and healthy fats deeply nourish the scalp and skin moisture barrier.
preparation_steps: Cook brown rice 30 min; fluff.
Cube tofu; pan-fry in olive oil 4-5 min per side until crispy.
Toss tofu with garlic, ginger, soy sauce and lemon; cook 1 min.
Boil edamame from frozen 4 min; drain.
Slice avocado.
Whisk miso paste with sesame oil, soy sauce, lemon juice and water for dressing.
Assemble bowl: brown rice base, crispy tofu, avocado, edamame.
Drizzle miso-sesame dressing; garnish with sesame seeds and spring onion.

description: Protein-rich chickpea salad with antioxidant cranberries, walnuts, and lemon herb dressing for skin glow. preparation_steps: Drain and rinse cooked chickpeas (150 g) thoroughly; pat completely dry with kitchen paper this is essential for crispiness.
Toss dried chickpeas with olive oil (5 g) and a pinch of salt; spread in a single layer on a baking tray.
Roast chickpeas at 200°C for 22–25 minutes, shaking tray halfway, until golden and crispy; cool completely.
Toast walnuts (25 g) in a dry pan over medium heat for 3–4 minutes until fragrant; cool then roughly chop.
Whisk together lemon juice (20 ml), olive oil (7 g), honey (5 g) and Dijon mustard (3 g) for the dressing.
Place mixed greens (80 g), cucumber (60 g), sliced red onion (30 g), fresh parsley (20 g) and dried cranberries (30 g) in a large salad bowl.
Add crispy roasted chickpeas and toasted walnuts to the bowl.
Drizzle dressing over salad and toss gently to coat all ingredients evenly.
Crumble feta cheese (30 g) over the top and serve immediately.

recipe_name: Egg & Vegetable Majboos with Beetroot Walnut Salad
description: Vegetable freekeh majboos with saffron-spiced eggs and antioxidant beetroot walnut salad. Eggs provide biotin and selenium for hair keratin synthesis and scalp health, while saffron crocin reduces melanin overproduction to diminish dark circles and uneven skin tone.
primary_goal: Skin Repair Dark Circles & Eye Bags
preparation_steps: Soak freekeh (70 g) in cold water for 15 minutes; drain well.
Sauté diced onion (50 g) and garlic (5 g) in olive oil (5 g) over medium heat for 4 minutes until soft.
Add bezaar spice (1 g), saffron (
3 g) steeped in 2 tbsp hot water, and turmeric (1 g); stir 1 minute.
Add diced zucchini (80 g), chopped tomatoes (60 g) and drained freekeh; pour in 350 ml water.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer 30 minutes until freekeh is tender and water absorbed.
Meanwhile boil eggs (2) for 8 minutes; cool in cold water, peel and halve.
Toast walnuts (25 g) in a dry pan for 3 minutes; cool and roughly chop.
Roast or grate raw beetroot (100 g); toss with walnuts, chopped parsley (20 g), lemon juice (15 ml) and olive oil (5 g).
Plate the freekeh majboos, place halved eggs on top and serve the beetroot walnut salad alongside.

recipe_name: Antioxidant Golden Coconut Soup with Chickpeas
description: Golden turmeric coconut soup with protein-rich chickpeas and anti-inflammatory spices for skin brightening. Curcumin from turmeric reduces UV-induced skin oxidative stress and inhibits melanin overproduction to brighten pigmentation, while coconut milk lauric acid supports skin barrier function.
preparation_steps: Heat olive oil (10 g) in a large pot over medium heat; add finely diced onion (50 g) and cook 5 minutes until soft.
Add minced garlic (5 g) and grated ginger (8 g); cook 2 minutes stirring constantly until fragrant.
Add turmeric (2 g), cumin (1 g) and ground coriander (1 g); stir 1 minute to toast spices in the oil.
Add chopped tomatoes (60 g); cook 5 minutes until softened and starting to break down.
Pour in coconut milk (150 ml) and 250 ml water; stir well to combine, scraping up any spices stuck to the bottom.
Add cooked chickpeas (120 g); season with salt; bring to a gentle boil then reduce to a simmer.
Simmer uncovered for 18–20 minutes until soup is rich, golden and slightly thickened.
Add baby spinach (60 g) in the last 3 minutes; stir until just wilted do not overcook.
Remove from heat; squeeze in lime juice (15 ml), stir and ladle into bowls; garnish generously with fresh coriander (15 g).

recipe_name: Asparagus Anti-Inflammatory Power Salad with Broccoli Soup
description: Anti-inflammatory asparagus power salad with creamy sulforaphane-rich broccoli soup for skin clarity. Asparagus provides glutathione    the body's master antioxidant    that protects skin from UV damage and reduces acne-causing oxidative stress, while broccoli sulforaphane activates cellular detoxification pathways.
preparation_steps: Snap woody ends off asparagus (150 g); bring a wide pan of salted water to a rapid boil.
Blanch asparagus for exactly 2–3 minutes until tender-crisp and bright green; transfer immediately to a bowl of ice water.
Drain chilled asparagus and pat dry; cut into 5 cm pieces.
For broccoli soup: sauté diced onion (40 g) and garlic (5 g) in olive oil for 4 minutes.
Add broccoli florets (200 g) and vegetable stock (250 ml); bring to a boil; simmer 15 minutes until broccoli is very tender.
Add turmeric (1 g); blend soup completely smooth with a stick blender; season with salt and lemon juice (10 ml).
In a large bowl combine asparagus, sliced avocado (80 g), mixed greens (80 g), pumpkin seeds (20 g) and sunflower seeds (15 g).
Whisk lemon juice (10 ml), olive oil (7 g) and turmeric (
5 g) for dressing; pour over salad and toss gently.
Ladle broccoli soup into a bowl alongside the plated asparagus power salad and serve immediately.

recipe_name: Buckwheat Polyphenol Power Bowl with Lentil Soup
description: Polyphenol-rich buckwheat bowl with berries, roasted beetroot, edamame, and warming lentil soup. Buckwheat rutin and quercetin strengthen blood vessel walls to reduce scalp hair follicle inflammation and combat hair fall, while mixed berries' anthocyanins neutralise free radicals that cause UV-induced.
preparation_steps: Rinse buckwheat (80 g) under cold water; toast in a dry pan 2 minutes until nutty and fragrant.
Cook toasted buckwheat in 160 ml water with a pinch of salt for 12–14 minutes; fluff and set aside to cool.
Dice raw beetroot (80 g); toss with olive oil and salt; roast at 200°C for 28 minutes until tender; cool.
Cook frozen edamame (60 g) in boiling salted water for 4 minutes; drain and cool.
For lentil soup: sauté diced onion (50 g) and garlic (5 g) in olive oil; add red lentils (60 g), 400 ml water, cumin (1 g) and turmeric (
Simmer lentil soup 20 minutes until completely soft; partially blend for a creamy texture; season with lemon juice (10 ml).
Whisk tahini (20 g) with lemon juice (10 ml) and 2 tbsp water until smooth and pourable for the dressing.
Assemble the bowl: buckwheat base, then edamame, mixed berries (50 g) and roasted beetroot arranged separately.
Drizzle tahini dressing over the bowl; serve warm lentil soup alongside in a separate bowl.

recipe_name: Boiled Eggs with Organic Quinoa & Mixed Green Salad
description: Whole wheat bread with boiled eggs, fluffy quinoa, and fresh mixed green salad for skin and hair repair. Eggs provide biotin and complete protein for hair keratin synthesis and skin collagen production, while whole wheat delivers B vitamins and prebiotic fibre to strengthen the gut-skin axis.
preparation_steps: Bring a saucepan of water to a full boil; lower eggs (2) in gently with a spoon.
Boil eggs for exactly 8 minutes for a fully set yolk; transfer to a bowl of cold water immediately.
Rinse quinoa (60 g) and cook in 120 ml salted water; simmer covered 14 minutes; fluff with a fork.
Peel eggs once cool; halve neatly and season the cut surface with a pinch of salt.
Wash and dry mixed greens (80 g); combine with sliced cucumber (60 g), cherry tomatoes (50 g) and fresh parsley (15 g).
Whisk lemon juice (15 ml) and olive oil (8 g) with a pinch of salt for the dressing.
Pour dressing over salad and toss gently to coat all leaves evenly.
Plate fluffy quinoa; place halved eggs on top and serve the mixed green salad alongside.

description: Probiotic sauerkraut and creamy guacamole in a whole wheat wrap with grilled chicken for gut-skin health. Sauerkraut live probiotic bacteria balance the gut microbiome to reduce acne-causing dysbiosis, while avocado oleic acid and vitamin E in the guacamole reinforce the skin's moisture barrier.
preparation_steps: Season chicken breast (120 g) with cumin (
5 g), minced garlic (3 g), olive oil (4 g) and salt.
Grill chicken on a preheated griddle 5–6 minutes each side until cooked through; rest 5 minutes.
Shred rested chicken into strips using two forks while still warm.
Halve avocado (80 g); remove stone; scoop flesh into a bowl and mash with lime juice (15 ml), minced garlic and salt to make guacamole.
Drain sauerkraut (60 g) through a fine sieve; press gently to remove excess brine.
Warm whole wheat wrap (80 g) in a dry pan for 30 seconds each side until pliable and soft.
Spread guacamole across the centre of the warm wrap leaving a 3 cm border all around.
Layer drained sauerkraut, shredded chicken, shredded lettuce (40 g), sliced tomatoes (50 g) and sliced red onion (30 g) on top of guacamole.
Mix whole wheat flour, yeast, a pinch of salt and warm water into a soft dough; knead 2 min.
Rest dough 15 min; roll into a thin round on a floured surface.

Cook on a hot dry griddle 1-2 min each side until lightly puffed and cooked through. Fold in the sides of the wrap tightly then roll from the bottom upward into a firm cylinder; cut on the diagonal and serve immediately.

recipe_name: Fish with Cashew Nuts and Roasted Brussels Sprouts
description: Cashew-herb crusted baked fish fillet with caramelised roasted Brussels sprouts for skin collagen repair. Fish omega-3 reduce scalp inflammation and protect skin lipid barrier integrity for fewer fine lines, while cashews' zinc and vitamin K support hair keratin production and skin wound.
preparation_steps: Halve Brussels sprouts (200 g) through the stem; toss with olive oil (5 g), turmeric (
5 g) and salt; spread cut-side down on a baking tray.
Roast Brussels sprouts at 220°C for 22–25 minutes until cut sides are deeply caramelised and leaves are crispy.
Toast cashews (30 g) in a dry pan for 3 minutes; cool then transfer to a processor.
Add fresh parsley (20 g), minced garlic (5 g) and Dijon mustard (5 g) to cashews; pulse to a coarse crumb crust do not over-process.
Pat white fish fillet (200 g) dry; season the flesh side with salt and pepper.
Press cashew crust firmly onto the top of the fish fillet, covering it evenly and thickly.
Place crusted fish on a lightly oiled baking tray; drizzle with lemon juice (10 ml).
Bake at 200°C for 16–18 minutes until crust is golden and fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.
Plate roasted Brussels sprouts on one side of the plate and the cashew-crusted fish on the other; garnish with lemon wedges.

description: Grilled chicken strips with creamy avocado, fresh mixed greens, and lemon herb dressing for skin anti-ageing. Lean chicken delivers complete protein and zinc for hair keratin synthesis and skin collagen production, while avocado oleic acid and glutathione protect skin from UV oxidative damage and.
preparation_steps: Pound chicken breast (160 g) lightly to an even thickness for uniform cooking; season with cumin (
5 g), garlic (3 g) and olive oil (5 g).
Preheat a griddle pan to high heat; grill chicken 5–6 minutes each side until cooked through with golden grill marks.
Rest grilled chicken 5 minutes before slicing this retains the juices.
Halve avocado (100 g); remove stone; slice into thin wedges or cube the flesh.
Whisk together lemon juice (20 ml), olive oil (5 g), minced garlic (2 g) and chopped parsley (15 g) to make the dressing.
Combine mixed greens (80 g), halved cherry tomatoes (60 g), sliced cucumber (60 g) and sliced red onion (30 g) in a large bowl.
Add avocado pieces to the salad bowl handle gently to keep avocado intact.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss very gently to coat everything without breaking the avocado.
Arrange salad in a wide bowl; fan the sliced grilled chicken over the top and serve immediately.

description: Creamy vitamin D mushroom and shredded chicken soup with herb-infused broth for hair follicle support. Mushroom vitamin D supports hair follicle cycling and reduces the scalp inflammation that causes miniaturisation and fall, while shredded chicken delivers complete protein for hair keratin synthesis.
preparation_steps: Poach chicken breast (150 g) in 400 ml chicken stock (300 ml) over medium heat for 18–20 minutes until cooked through; remove and shred with two forks.
Clean and slice mixed mushrooms (150 g) quarter large ones, halve medium ones.
Heat olive oil (5 g) in a large pot; sauté diced onion (50 g) for 4 minutes; add minced garlic (5 g) and cook 1 minute.
Add sliced mushrooms in a single layer; cook without stirring for 4 minutes until deeply golden; stir and cook 2 more minutes.
Pour in the reserved poaching stock and add fresh thyme (5 g) and turmeric (
5 g); bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes; remove thyme sprigs.
Ladle half the soup into a blender or use a stick blender to partially blend this creates creaminess while keeping some mushroom texture.
Return blended soup to the pot; stir in coconut cream (40 ml) and shredded chicken; simmer 5 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice (10 ml), adjust salt and pepper; ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh parsley (15 g).

description: Grilled chicken in fragrant basil pesto with mixed greens, pine nuts, and cherry tomatoes for clear skin. Basil's eugenol and linalool have antimicrobial properties that reduce acne-causing bacteria, while pine nuts provide zinc to regulate sebum production and vitamin E for skin moisture barrier repair.
preparation_steps: Pound chicken breast (180 g) to an even 2 cm thickness; season with salt and pepper.
Grill chicken on a preheated high-heat griddle 5–6 minutes each side until golden and cooked through; rest 5 minutes.
Toast pine nuts (25 g) in a dry pan over low heat for 3–4 minutes, stirring constantly, until golden watch carefully as they burn quickly.
Blend fresh basil leaves (30 g), toasted pine nuts (20 g reserve 5 g for garnish), grated parmesan (20 g), garlic (3 g) and olive oil (15 g) until fairly smooth; season pesto with salt.
Slice rested chicken across the grain into thick strips; place in a bowl while still warm.
Toss warm chicken strips in 2–3 tablespoons of the fresh pesto until well coated.
Arrange mixed greens (80 g), halved cherry tomatoes (60 g) and sliced cucumber (50 g) on a wide plate.
Place pesto chicken strips over the salad; drizzle any remaining pesto around the plate.
Finish with reserved toasted pine nuts and shaved parmesan; serve immediately.

description: Golden baked tofu over brown rice with rainbow roasted vegetables and tahini-miso dressing for skin health. Tofu isoflavones support hormonal balance to manage oestrogen-related hair loss and skin hydration, while miso probiotics maintain the gut-skin microbiome to reduce acne.
preparation_steps: Press firm tofu (150 g) between weighted plates for 20 minutes; cut into 2 cm cubes.
Mix soy sauce (5 ml) and sesame oil (3 ml); toss tofu cubes in the marinade for 15 minutes.
Spread marinated tofu on a lined baking tray; bake at 200°C for 25 minutes, turning once, until golden and firm on all sides.
Rinse brown rice (70 g) and cook in 150 ml water; simmer covered 28–30 minutes; fluff.
Chop bell pepper (80 g), broccoli (80 g) into florets, dice sweet potato (80 g) and slice zucchini (60 g); toss all with olive oil (5 g) and salt.
Roast vegetables at 220°C for 22–25 minutes, turning once halfway, until golden with caramelised edges.
Whisk tahini (20 g), white miso (10 g), lemon juice (15 ml) and 3 tbsp water together until smooth and creamy for the dressing.
Assemble the bowl: brown rice base, roasted vegetables arranged around the edge, golden tofu cubes in the centre.
Drizzle tahini-miso dressing over the entire bowl; finish with sesame seeds (10 g).

description: Crispy whole wheat shrimp quesadillas with protein-rich chickpea herb salad for skin clarity. Shrimp iodine and selenium support thyroid function to prevent hormonal hair fall, while low-fat cheese provides calcium and protein for hair shaft strength and skin collagen support.
preparation_steps: Peel and devein white shrimp (120 g); pat completely dry and season with cumin (1 g), paprika (
5 g), garlic (
5 g) and salt.
Roast bell pepper (60 g) whole under a hot grill for 15 minutes, turning, until charred all over; cool then peel, deseed and slice.
Cook seasoned shrimp in a hot dry pan for 2 minutes each side until pink and just cooked; set aside.
Lay whole wheat tortilla (80 g) flat; scatter low-fat cheese (40 g) over one half, add shrimp and roasted pepper strips.
Fold tortilla in half to enclose filling; press firmly to seal.
Cook quesadilla in a dry non-stick pan over medium heat 3 minutes each side until crispy, golden and cheese is melted.
Toss cooked chickpeas (100 g) with fresh parsley (20 g), mint (10 g), minced garlic (
5 g), lemon juice (10 ml) and olive oil (5 g) for the herb salad.
Let quesadilla rest 2 minutes; cut into 3 triangular wedges.
Plate quesadilla wedges with the chickpea herb salad in a bowl alongside.

recipe_name: BBQ Chicken Sandwich with Green Salad
description: Smoky BBQ grilled chicken in whole wheat bread with fresh greens and herb yogurt for gut-skin health. Lean chicken delivers complete protein for hair keratin synthesis and skin collagen production, while yogurt probiotics maintain the gut-skin axis to reduce acne-causing dysbiosis.
preparation_steps: Mix cumin (1 g), paprika (1 g) and garlic powder (
5 g) for BBQ spice blend; season chicken breast (160 g) generously.
Drizzle spiced chicken with olive oil (4 g) and a squeeze of lemon; marinate 20 minutes.
Grill chicken on preheated high-heat grill 5–6 minutes each side until cooked through and nicely charred; rest 5 minutes then slice.
Mix low-fat yogurt (50 g) with chopped fresh parsley (10 g), a tiny clove of minced garlic and a squeeze of lemon for the herb sauce.
Toast whole wheat bread (80 g) slices lightly until golden but not hard.
Spread herb yogurt sauce generously on both toasted bread slices.
Layer lettuce (40 g), sliced tomatoes (50 g) and BBQ chicken slices on one bread slice; close with the second slice.
Toss rocket (40 g) and sliced cucumber (60 g) with olive oil (4 g), lemon juice (10 ml) and a pinch of salt for the green salad.
Cut sandwich diagonally and serve with the green salad alongside.

recipe_name: Creamy Coconut and Turmeric Soup with Tofu
description: Golden turmeric coconut soup with silken tofu, ginger, and anti-inflammatory spices for skin pigmentation. Curcumin from turmeric inhibits melanin overproduction to brighten skin pigmentation, while coconut milk lauric acid supports skin barrier function.
preparation_steps: Drain silken tofu (150 g); cut into 2 cm cubes handle gently as silken tofu is very delicate.
Heat olive oil (8 g) in a wide soup pot over medium heat; sauté finely diced onion (50 g) for 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic (5 g), grated ginger (8 g) and bruised lemongrass stalk (5 g); cook 3 minutes until very fragrant.
Add turmeric (2 g); stir 1 minute to bloom in the oil the colour will deepen significantly.
Pour in coconut milk (150 ml) and vegetable stock (200 ml); stir to combine; bring to a gentle simmer.
Simmer soup uncovered for 15 minutes to allow flavours to meld; remove lemongrass stalk.
Carefully lower tofu cubes into the simmering soup using a slotted spoon; cook very gently 5 minutes.
Add baby spinach (80 g) in the last 3 minutes; stir gently until just wilted avoid breaking tofu.
Remove from heat; squeeze in lime juice (15 ml); ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh coriander (15 g).

recipe_name: Chicken and Eggplant Gratin with Red Cabbage Salad
description: Chicken and eggplant layered in tomato gratin with a crisp antioxidant-rich red cabbage salad. Chicken delivers complete protein for hair keratin synthesis and skin collagen production, while eggplant anthocyanins protect skin collagen from UV oxidative damage.
preparation_steps: Slice eggplant (200 g) into 1 cm rounds; sprinkle both sides with salt and rest 15 minutes; rinse and pat dry.
Grill eggplant slices on a hot griddle pan 2–3 minutes each side until softened and marked; set aside.
Slice chicken breast (150 g) into strips; season with cumin (1 g), cinnamon (
3 g) and salt.
Sauté diced onion (50 g) and garlic (5 g) in olive oil (5 g) for 4 minutes; add chicken strips and cook until golden about 5 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes (120 g) to the chicken; simmer 10 minutes until thick and fragrant.
In a baking dish, layer grilled eggplant then pour chicken tomato sauce over the top; cover evenly.
Scatter grated low-fat mozzarella (40 g) over the top; bake at 180°C for 20 minutes until bubbling and golden.
While gratin bakes, shred red cabbage (120 g) finely; toss with grated apple (60 g), chopped parsley (15 g), lemon juice (15 ml) and olive oil (4 g).
Rest gratin 5 minutes after removing from oven; serve hot with red cabbage salad alongside.

recipe_name: Spinach Lentil Soup with Carrot Parsley Salad
description: Iron-rich spinach and lentil soup with bright beta-carotene carrot and parsley salad for hair nourishment. Spinach iron and lentil folate together oxygenate hair follicles to reduce anaemia-related hair fall    the most common nutritional cause of hair loss .
preparation_steps: Rinse red lentils (80 g) under cold water until water runs clear; drain.
Heat olive oil (5 g) in a pot; sauté diced onion (50 g) for 4 minutes until golden; add minced garlic (8 g) and cook 1 minute.
Add cumin (2 g) and turmeric (
5 g); stir 1 minute to toast spices in the oil.
Add drained lentils and 600 ml water; bring to a rolling boil; skim any foam.
Reduce heat; simmer uncovered for 18–20 minutes until lentils are completely soft and breaking down.
Add washed baby spinach (100 g); stir gently and cook 4–5 minutes until wilted; squeeze in lemon juice (20 ml).
Use a stick blender to partially blend the soup leave some texture for a hearty consistency; adjust salt.
Coarsely grate carrots (120 g); combine with chopped fresh parsley (30 g), lemon juice (10 ml) and olive oil (5 g); toss well.
Ladle hot spinach lentil soup into a bowl; season to taste and serve carrot parsley salad in a separate bowl alongside.

description: Emirati vegetable margoogat stew with egg and spinach Florentine omelette for skin collagen and hair repair. Eggs provide biotin and complete protein for hair keratin synthesis and skin collagen production during overnight repair, while spinach iron and folate oxygenate hair follicles.
preparation_steps: Make marqooq dough: mix whole wheat flour (60 g), a pinch of salt and water to a smooth, very soft dough; rest 20 minutes.
Sauté diced onion (50 g) and garlic (5 g) in olive oil (5 g) for 4 minutes; add turmeric (1 g), cumin (1 g) and chopped tomatoes (100 g); cook 8 minutes.
Add diced zucchini (80 g) and carrot (60 g) with 300 ml water; season and simmer 20 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Divide marqooq dough into small balls; roll each one paper-thin on a floured surface.
Cook each marqooq sheet on a hot dry griddle for 1–2 minutes each side until dry and lightly crispy.
Break marqooq sheets into rough pieces in a wide, deep serving dish; ladle hot vegetable stew generously over the bread; leave 2–3 minutes for bread to absorb the broth.
Wash spinach (80 g); sauté in olive oil (3 g) with garlic for 3 minutes until wilted; season and spread in a small pan.
Beat eggs (2) with a pinch of salt; pour over the spinach; cook on medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes until just set do not stir.
Plate the margoogat in a bowl and serve the omelette Florentine alongside.

recipe_name: Emirati Lentil Rice with Steamed Broccoli
description: Emirati cumin-spiced lentil rice with caramelised onions and sulforaphane-rich steamed broccoli. Lentil iron and folate oxygenate hair follicles to reduce anaemia-related hair fall, while broccoli sulforaphane activates cellular detoxification to reduce acne-causing oxidative stress.
preparation_steps: Slice onions (80 g) very thin; heat olive oil (6 g) in a heavy pan over the lowest heat possible.
Cook onions slowly for 25–30 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until deeply caramelised, sweet and dark golden this is the soul of the dish.
Meanwhile rinse lentils (70 g) and cook in 300 ml water for 12–15 minutes until just tender but not mushy; keep any cooking water.
Rinse basmati rice (80 g) until water runs clear; soak in cold water 15 minutes; drain.
Combine drained lentils, soaked rice and cumin (2 g) in the pot; add 200 ml water; season with salt.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat to the lowest setting; cover with a tight lid and cook 18 minutes.
Remove from heat; place a folded kitchen towel under the lid; rest 5 minutes this absorbs steam for fluffy rice.
Fill a pot with 5 cm water; bring to a boil; place broccoli florets (200 g) in a steamer basket above; cover and steam 4–5 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.
Plate the lentil rice topped with golden caramelised onions; serve steamed broccoli dressed with lemon juice (15 ml) and olive oil (4 g) alongside.

recipe_name: Creamy Spinach & Cheese Club Sandwich with Skin Glow Shot
description: Creamy spinach and cheese whole wheat club sandwich with a vibrant skin glow shot. Spinach iron and folate oxygenate hair follicles to reduce fall, while cheese protein and calcium strengthen hair shafts and support skin collagen production.
preparation_steps: Wash baby spinach (80 g) thoroughly; heat olive oil (4 g) in a pan and add minced garlic (3 g); sauté 30 seconds.
Add spinach to the pan; cook over medium heat 2–3 minutes until wilted; season with salt; cool 5 minutes.
Combine wilted spinach with low-fat cream cheese (40 g); mix until evenly incorporated into a creamy filling.
Toast all three slices of whole wheat bread (100 g, 3 slices) until golden firm enough to hold the triple layers.
Spread creamy spinach mixture generously on the first slice of toast; lay it flat.
Place the second toast slice on top; scatter sliced low-fat mozzarella (30 g) and sliced tomatoes (40 g) over it.
Place the third toast slice on top to complete the club; press firmly and cut into 4 triangles using a serrated knife.
For the skin glow shot: juice fresh carrot (80 g) and ginger (5 g) together; mix with turmeric (1 g), lemon juice (20 ml) and a pinch of black pepper.
Pour the glow shot into a small shot glass; serve alongside the club sandwich triangles arranged on a plate.

recipe_name: Chickpea & Sweet Potato Saloona with Steamed Broccoli
description: Emirati chickpea and sweet potato saloona stew with sulforaphane-rich steamed broccoli. Sweet potato beta-carotene converts to vitamin A to regulate sebum and brighten pigmentation, while chickpea zinc reduces acne-causing sebum overproduction and supports hair follicle repair.
preparation_steps: Peel and dice sweet potato (150 g) into 2 cm cubes; rinse cooked chickpeas (120 g) and drain.
Heat olive oil (5 g) in a deep pot; sauté diced onion (60 g) for 5 minutes until soft and translucent.
Add minced garlic (5 g), turmeric (1 g), cumin (1 g) and ground coriander (1 g); stir 1 minute to toast spices.
Add chopped tomatoes (100 g); cook 8 minutes stirring until thick and fragrant.
Add sweet potato cubes and chickpeas; pour in 400 ml water; season with salt.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 22–25 minutes until sweet potato is completely tender.
Squeeze in lemon juice (15 ml); taste and adjust seasoning; garnish with fresh coriander (10 g).
Fill a pot with 5 cm water and bring to a boil; place broccoli florets (180 g) in a steamer basket; steam 4–5 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.
Dress broccoli with lemon juice and olive oil; serve saloona in a deep bowl with steamed broccoli alongside.

recipe_name: Summer Fresh Tomato Soup with Grilled Chicken
description: Fresh vibrant tomato basil soup with lean herb-marinated grilled chicken breast for skin clarity. Tomato lycopene is the most potent carotenoid antioxidant for protecting skin from UV-induced oxidative damage and reducing acne-causing inflammation, while basil antimicrobial compounds reduce Propionibacterium acnes bacteria on.
